        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      }
      
      .tray-stat-k {
        display: block;
        font-size: 0.52rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.14em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--ink-faint);
      }
      
      .tray-stat-v {
        display: block;
        margin-top: 0.15rem;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--ink);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      
      .tray-cta {
        font-size: 0.76rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--ink-faint);
        transition: color 0.2s var(--ease-out);
      }
      
      .tray-card:hover .tray-cta {
        color: var(--signal);
      }
      
      .tray-delete {
        position: absolute;
        right: 0.5rem;
        bottom: 0.5rem;
        padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
        border: 1px solid transparent;
        border-radius: 2px;
        background: transparent;
        color: var(--ink-faint);
        font-size: 0.55rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.14em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition:
          color 0.2s var(--ease-out),
          border-color 0.2s var(--ease-out),
          background 0.2s var(--ease-out);
      }
      
      .tray-delete:hover:not(:disabled),
      .tray-delete:focus-visible:not(:disabled) {
        color: var(--danger);
        border-color: var(--danger);
      }
      
      .tray-delete.is-armed {
        color: var(--danger);
        border-color: var(--danger);
        background: var(--danger-bg);
      }
      
      .tray-delete:disabled {
        opacity: 0.28;
        cursor: not-allowed;
      }
      
      .tray-create {
        position: relative;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        gap: 0.28rem;
        width: 100%;
        min-height: 210px;
        padding: 1.15rem 1.2rem;
        border: 1px dashed var(--border-strong);
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        background: var(--surface);
        color: var(--ink);
        font: inherit;
        text-align: left;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition:
          border-color 0.25s var(--ease-out),
          background 0.25s var(--ease-out);
      }
      
      .tray-create:hover:not(:disabled) {
        border-color: var(--signal);
        background: var(--signal-soft);
      }
      
      .tray-create:disabled {
        opacity: 0.55;
        cursor: default;
      }
      
      .tray-create-mark {
        position: absolute;
        top: 1rem;
        right: 1.1rem;
        width: 2.2rem;
        height: 2.2rem;
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        background: var(--signal);
        color: var(--signal-ink);
        font-size: 1.3rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 1;
        transition: transform 0.25s var(--ease-out);
      }
      
      .tray-create:hover:not(:disabled) .tray-create-mark {
        transform: rotate(90deg);
      }
      
      .tray-create-k {
        font-size: 0.55rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.16em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--ink-faint);
      }
      
      .tray-create-title {
        font-size: 1.2rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.01em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--ink);
      }
      
      .tray-create-cta {
        margin-top: 0.3rem;
        font-size: 0.76rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--signal);
      }
      
      .home-footer {
        padding: 0.9rem 1.5rem 1.2rem;
        text-align: center;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.62rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.14em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--ink-faint);
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        background: var(--surface);
      }
      
      @media (max-width: 720px) {
        .home-project {
          display: none;
        }
        .home-new {
          padding: 0 0.7rem;
          font-size: 0.68rem;
        }
        .home-facts > div {
          padding: 0.6rem 0.7rem 0.65rem;
        }
        .home-facts dt {
          font-size: 0.5rem;
          letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }
        .home-facts dd {
          font-size: 0.95rem;
        }
        .tray-grid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }
        .tray-card,
        .tray-create {
          min-height: 190px;
        }
      }
      
      /* --- header (chrome bar + tick rail) --- */
      
      .topbar {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 40;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.85rem;
        padding: 0.4rem 1.1rem;
        min-height: 3.5rem;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1a212c 0%, #121722 100%);
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
        flex-shrink: 0;
        box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) inset;
      }
      
      .topbar::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        bottom: -1px;
        height: 5px;
        background: var(--tick);
        background-size: 10px 4px;
        background-repeat: repeat-x;
        background-position: bottom;
        opacity: 0.5;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      
      .brand {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        background: none;
        border: none;
        cursor: pointer;
        padding: 0;
      }
      
      .brand-mark { cursor: default; }
      
      /* The wordmark is a transparent PNG cropped to its ink, so it sits on the dark
         bar without a nameplate behind it. */
      .brand-logo {
        display: block;
        width: auto;
        height: 1.35rem;
        object-fit: contain;
      }
      
      .topbar-spacer {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
      }
      
      .topbar .session-action {
        flex-shrink: 0;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      
      /* --- main layout --- */
      
      .layout {
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 0;
        min-width: 0;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 200px minmax(0, 1fr) var(--inspector-width);
        grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr);
      }
      
      .library-rail {
        min-height: 0;
        min-width: 0;
        overflow: auto;
        background: var(--panel);
        border-right: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
        position: relative;
      }
      
      .library-rail::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        width: 6px;
        background: var(--tick-v);
        opacity: 0.45;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      
      .workspace-main {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        min-width: 0;
        min-height: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        position: relative;
        padding: var(--space-2);
        gap: var(--space-2);
        background: var(--bg);
      }
      
      .inspector {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        min-height: 0;
        min-width: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        background: var(--panel);
        border-left: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
        position: relative;
      }
      
      .inspector::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        width: 8px;
        background: var(--tick-v);
        background-size: 4px 14px;
        background-repeat: repeat-y;
        background-position: left top;
        opacity: 0.45;
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 3;
      }
      
      /* --- viewport: the measuring well --- */
      
      .viewport {
        position: relative;
        flex: 1 1 auto;
        min-height: min(58vh, 640px);
        background: var(--surface-dark);
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        overflow: hidden;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        border: 1px solid #2a2e36;
      }
      
      .viewport canvas { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
      
      .viewport::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        inset: 10px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.08);
        border-radius: 2px;
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 1;
        background:
          linear-gradient(to right, transparent calc(50% - 0.5px), rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.07) calc(50% - 0.5px), rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.07) calc(50% + 0.5px), transparent calc(50% + 0.5px)),
          linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent calc(50% - 0.5px), rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.07) calc(50% - 0.5px), rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.07) calc(50% + 0.5px), transparent calc(50% + 0.5px));
      }
      
      .viewport-tag {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0.85rem;
        left: 0.95rem;
        z-index: 2;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.62rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        color: rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.75);
        background: rgba(14, 16, 20, 0.75);
        border: 1px solid rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.12);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.28rem 0.65rem;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      
      .viewport-toolbar {
        position: absolute;
        left: 0.95rem;
        right: 0.95rem;
        bottom: 0.85rem;
        z-index: 2;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 0.6rem;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      
      .viewport-controls,
      .viewport-actions {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.45rem;
        min-width: 0;
      }
      
      /* Surface finish switch — the only viewport control that changes the model's
         look rather than the camera. Compact enough to sit beside the hint. */
      .material-switch {
        pointer-events: auto;
        display: flex;
        align-items: stretch;
        background: rgba(14, 16, 20, 0.85);
        border: 1px solid rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.18);
        border-radius: 2px;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      
      .material-option {
        font-family: var(--sans);
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.55);
        background: transparent;
        border: none;
        border-right: 1px solid rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.12);
        padding: 0.42rem 0.6rem;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;
      }
      
      .material-option:last-child { border-right: none; }
      
      .material-option:hover { color: rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.9); }
      
      .material-option.is-active {
        color: #fff;
        background: rgba(204, 41, 54, 0.28);
        box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--signal);
      }
      
      .viewport-hint {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.6rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        color: rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.5);
        background: rgba(14, 16, 20, 0.75);
        border: 1px solid rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.1);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.3rem 0.65rem;
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }
      
      .viewport-reset {
        pointer-events: auto;
        flex: none;
        font-family: var(--sans);
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        white-space: nowrap;
        color: rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.9);
        background: rgba(14, 16, 20, 0.85);
        border: 1px solid rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.18);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
      }
      
      .viewport-reset:hover:not(:disabled) {
        border-color: var(--signal);
        color: #fff;
      }
      
      .viewport-reset:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: default; }
      
      .viewport-overlay {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 3;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 0.65rem;
        text-align: center;
        padding: 2rem;
        background: rgba(14, 16, 20, 0.92);
        color: rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.92);
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        animation: fade-in 0.25s ease both;
      }
      
      .viewport-overlay-busy {
        background: rgba(14, 16, 20, 0.82);
        backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
      }
      
      .overlay-title {
        font-size: 1.15rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }
      
      .overlay-text {
        font-size: 0.92rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        color: rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.55);
        max-width: 26rem;
      }
      
      .overlay-note {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        color: rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.4);
      }
      
      .overlay-examples {
        list-style: none;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 0.45rem;
        margin-top: 0.5rem;
      }
      
      .example-link {
        font-family: var(--sans);
        font-size: 0.84rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        color: rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.85);
        background: rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.06);
        border: 1px solid rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.18);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.55rem 1rem;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
      }
      
      .example-link:hover {
        border-color: var(--signal);
        background: rgba(204, 41, 54, 0.18);
      }
      
      /* --- prompt bar (thimble) --- */
      
      .prompt-bar {
        flex-shrink: 0;
        background: var(--surface);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        position: relative;
      }
      
      .prompt-bar::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        top: 0;
        height: 3px;
        background: var(--tick);
        background-size: 8px 3px;
        opacity: 0.45;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      
      .prompt-bar-inner {
        display: flex;
        gap: 0.6rem;
        align-items: stretch;
      }
      
      .prompt-input {
        flex: 1;
        resize: none;
        min-height: 2.5rem;
        max-height: 7rem;
        font: inherit;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--input);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem;
        line-height: 1.4;
        transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
      }
      
      .prompt-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-faint); font-weight: 500; }
      
      .prompt-input:hover:not(:disabled):not(:focus) {
        background: var(--input-hover);
        border-color: var(--border-strong);
      }
      
      .prompt-input:focus {
        outline: none;
        border-color: var(--signal);
        background: var(--input);
        box-shadow: none;
      }
      
      .prompt-input:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; }
      
      .prompt-footer {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        margin-top: 0.35rem;
      }
      
      .char-count {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        color: var(--ink-faint);
      }
      
      .generate-button {
        flex-shrink: 0;
        align-self: stretch;
        min-height: 2.5rem;
        min-width: 7.5rem;
        background: var(--signal);
        color: var(--signal-ink);
        border: none;
        border-radius: 2px;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
        cursor: pointer;
        box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14) inset, 0 6px 18px rgba(204, 41, 54, 0.35);
        transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s var(--ease-out);
      }
      
      .generate-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
        background: var(--signal-hover);
      }
      
      .generate-button:active:not(:disabled) {
        transform: translateY(1px);
      }
      
      .generate-button:disabled {
        opacity: 0.4;
        cursor: default;
      }
      
      .error-box {
        margin-top: 0.75rem;
        background: var(--danger-bg);
        border: 1px solid var(--signal);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.7rem 0.95rem;
        animation: fade-rise 0.25s var(--ease-out) both;
      }
      
      .error-title {
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--danger);
      }
      
      .error-text {
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
        margin-top: 0.15rem;
      }
      
      /* --- inspector --- */
      
      .inspector-header {
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        z-index: 2;
        padding: 0.85rem 1.15rem 0.85rem 1.35rem;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.18em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--surface);
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }
      
      .inspector-body {
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 0;
        overflow-y: auto;
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
        padding: 0.5rem 0;
      }
      
      .inspector-empty {
        padding: 2.5rem 1.25rem;
        text-align: center;
        color: var(--ink-faint);
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        font-weight: 500;
      }
      
      .inspector-section {
        padding: 0.9rem 1.15rem 0.9rem 1.35rem;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        animation: fade-rise 0.3s var(--ease-out) both;
      }
      
      .inspector-section:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
      
      .inspector-label {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.62rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.14em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
        margin-bottom: 0.55rem;
      }
      
      .inspector-value {
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--ink);
        line-height: 1.4;
      }
      
      .inspector-row {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: baseline;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        padding: 0.3rem 0;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
      }
      
      .inspector-row dt { color: var(--ink-secondary); font-weight: 500; flex-shrink: 0; }
      .inspector-row dd {
        text-align: right;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        color: var(--ink);
      }
      
      .inspector-mono {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        color: var(--ink);
      }
      
      .inspector-feature {
        padding: 0.45rem 0.65rem;
        border-radius: 2px;
        margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        color: var(--ink);
        line-height: 1.4;
        background: var(--surface);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
      }
      
      .inspector-feature:first-child {
        background: var(--surface);
      }
      
      .inspector-feature-name {
        font-weight: 700;
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 0.1rem;
      }
      
      .inspector-feature-detail {
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
        font-size: 0.7rem;
      }
      
      .inspector-file {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        padding: 0.45rem 0;
      }
      
      .inspector-file-name {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        color: var(--ink);
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        white-space: nowrap;
        min-width: 0;
      }
      
      .inspector-file-meta {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.4rem;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }
      
      .inspector-file-format {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.6rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        color: var(--ink);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
        background: var(--surface-subtle);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.1rem 0.4rem;
      }
      
      .inspector-file-size {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        color: var(--ink-faint);
      }
      
      .inspector-download {
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--ink);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem;
        text-decoration: none;
        background: var(--surface);
        cursor: pointer;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
      }
      
      .inspector-download:hover {
        border-color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--surface-subtle);
      }
      
      .inspector-validation {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.4rem;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--ink);
      }
      
      .inspector-build-summary {
        margin-top: 0.4rem;
        padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
        background: var(--surface-subtle);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 2px;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.75rem;
      }
      
      .inspector-meta {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        padding: 0.2rem 0;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
      }
      
      .inspector-meta dt { color: var(--ink-secondary); }
      .inspector-meta dd {
        color: var(--ink);
        font-weight: 600;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.7rem;
      }
      
      /* --- generation loader --- */
      
      .generation-loader {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.4rem;
      }
      
      .generation-loader .pipeline-title {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.16em;
        color: rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.55);
        margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
      }
      
      .generation-loader-machine {
        height: 100px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
      }
      
      .pipeline {
        list-style: none;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 0.25rem;
        align-self: stretch;
      }
      
      .pipeline-step {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.45rem;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        color: rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.35);
        animation: pipeline-emphasis 2.1s ease-in-out infinite;
      }
      
      .pipeline-step .step-mark { width: 0.75rem; text-align: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
      
      @keyframes pipeline-emphasis {
        0%, 15% { color: #ff6b75; opacity: 1; }
        30%, 100% { color: rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.35); opacity: 0.75; }
      }
      
      /* --- walking machine --- */
      
      .wm { position: relative; width: 200px; height: 200px; pointer-events: none; }
      .wm svg { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; }
      .wm .wm-head { translate: 27px -30px; z-index: 3; animation: wm-bob 1s infinite ease-in; }
      .wm .wm-bod { translate: 0px 30px; z-index: 3; animation: wm-bob 1s infinite ease-in-out; }
      .wm .wm-legr { translate: 75px 135px; z-index: 0; animation: wm-rstep 1s infinite ease-in; animation-delay: 0.45s; }
      .wm .wm-legl { translate: 30px 155px; z-index: 3; animation: wm-lstep 1s infinite ease-in; }
      .wm .wm-ground { z-index: -1; opacity: 0.5; animation: wm-scroll 5s infinite linear; }
      
      /* Night shift: re-light the machine body for the dark bench. The red eye
       * and headlamp stay as authored; CSS fill/stroke beat SVG attributes. */
      .wm [fill="#171816"] { fill: #c7cfd8; }
      .wm [stroke="#171816"] { stroke: #c7cfd8; }
      .wm [stroke="#3c3f39"] { stroke: #7e8894; }
      
      @keyframes wm-bob {
        0%, 5% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(3deg); }
        25% { transform: translateY(5px) rotate(0deg); }
        50% { transform: translateY(0px) rotate(-3deg); }
        70% { transform: translateY(5px) rotate(0deg); }
        100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(3deg); }
      }
      
      @keyframes wm-lstep {
        0% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(-5deg); }
        33% { transform: translateY(-15px) translate(32px) rotate(35deg); }
        66% { transform: translateY(0) translate(25px) rotate(-25deg); }
        100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(-5deg); }
      }
      
      @keyframes wm-rstep {
        0% { transform: translateY(0) translate(0px) rotate(-5deg); }
        33% { transform: translateY(-10px) translate(30px) rotate(35deg); }
        66% { transform: translateY(0) translate(20px) rotate(-25deg); }
        100% { transform: translateY(0) translate(0px) rotate(-5deg); }
      }
      
      @keyframes wm-scroll {
        0% { transform: translateY(25px) translate(50px); opacity: 0; }
        33% { opacity: 0.5; }
        66% { opacity: 0.5; }
        100% { transform: translateY(-50px) translate(-100px); opacity: 0; }
      }
      
      /* --- boot screen --- */
      
      .boot-screen {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 50;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 0.4rem;
        background: var(--bg);
        opacity: 1;
        transition: opacity 0.35s var(--ease-out);
        border-top: 4px solid var(--signal);
      }
      
      .boot-screen-exit { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
      
      .boot-logo {
        width: auto;
        height: 2.4rem;
        object-fit: contain;
      }
      
      .boot-subtitle {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.28em;
        text-indent: 0.28em;
        color: var(--signal);
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
      }
      
      .boot-checklist {
        list-style: none;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 0.35rem;
        margin-top: 1rem;
        min-width: 14rem;
      }
      
      .boot-row {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.6rem;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        color: var(--ink-faint);
      }
      
      .boot-row .boot-mark { width: 1rem; text-align: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
      .boot-row.done { color: var(--ink); }
      .boot-row.done .boot-mark { color: var(--signal); font-weight: 700; }
      
      .boot-status {
        margin-top: 0.8rem;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.22em;
        color: var(--ink);
      }
      
      .boot-footer {
        margin-top: 1.2rem;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.62rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.18em;
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
      }
      
      /* --- panels / spec --- */
      
      .panel {
        background: var(--surface);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem 1.2rem;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      }
      
      .panel-title {
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.14em;
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
        margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
        padding-bottom: 0.45rem;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      }
      
      .field-label {
        display: block;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
      }
      
      .spec-name {
        font-size: 1.15rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.02em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }
      
      .spec-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
      
      .spec-row {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 0.75rem;
        padding: 0.4rem 0;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        font-size: 0.85rem;
      }
      
      .spec-row:first-child { border-top: none; }
      .spec-row dt { color: var(--ink-secondary); font-weight: 500; flex-shrink: 0; }
      .spec-row dd {
        text-align: right;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        font-weight: 600;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      
      .mono {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      
      .spec-bytes {
        color: var(--ink);
        font-weight: 600;
      }
      
      .spec-subtitle {
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.14em;
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
        font-family: var(--mono);
        margin: 1rem 0 0.35rem;
      }
      
      .op-tree {
        list-style: none;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.76rem;
        background: var(--surface-subtle);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem;
      }
      
      .op-tree li {
        padding: 0.2rem 0.35rem;
        border-radius: 2px;
      }
      .op-tree li:first-child {
        background: var(--surface);
        font-weight: 600;
      }
      
      .build-row {
        margin-top: 0.9rem;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
        border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-strong);
        padding-top: 0.65rem;
      }
      
      .build-check { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }
      
      .file-list { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; }
      
      .file-row {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 0.75rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.7rem 0.85rem;
        background: var(--surface);
        transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
      }
      
      .file-row:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
      
      .file-meta { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.55rem; min-width: 0; font-size: 0.82rem; }
      
      .file-format {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        color: var(--ink);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
        background: var(--surface-subtle);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.1rem 0.4rem;
      }
      
      .file-name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
      
      .file-size {
        color: var(--ink-faint);
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        white-space: nowrap;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      
      .download-button {
        flex-shrink: 0;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--ink);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem;
        text-decoration: none;
        background: var(--surface);
        transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
      }
      
      .download-button:hover {
        border-color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--surface-subtle);
      }
      
      .files-note { margin-top: 0.65rem; font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--ink-faint); }
      
      /* --- action buttons (topbar) --- */
      
      .session-action {
        border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
        background: var(--surface);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.35rem 0.9rem;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        cursor: pointer;
        color: var(--ink);
        transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
      }
      
      .session-action:hover:not(:disabled) {
        border-color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--surface-subtle);
      }
      
      .session-action:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }
      
      /* --- revision history --- */
      
      .rev-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; }
      
      .rev-item {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 0.12rem;
        text-align: left;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        background: var(--surface);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.5rem 0.7rem;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
      }
      
      .rev-item:hover:not(:disabled) {
        border-color: var(--border-strong);
      }
      
      .rev-item.active {
        border-color: var(--signal);
        background: var(--signal-soft);
      }
      
      .rev-item-title {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        color: var(--ink);
      }
      
      .rev-item-prompt {
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }
      
      /* --- parametric panel (DRO) --- */
      
      .param-group {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.62rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.14em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--ink-faint);
        margin: 0.65rem 0 0.25rem;
      }
      
      .param-row {
        padding: 0.4rem 0;
        border-radius: 2px;
        transition: background 0.15s ease;
      }
      
      .param-row:hover { background: rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.05); }
      
      .param-head {
        display: flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 0.5rem;
      }
      
      .param-label {
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
      }
      
      .param-value {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        gap: 0.3rem;
      }
      
      .param-input {
        width: 5.4rem;
        text-align: right;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 1.2rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        color: #e8eaed;
        background: var(--surface-dark);
        border: 1px solid #2a2e36;
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.28rem 0.4rem;
        transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
      }
      
      .param-input:hover:not(:disabled) {
        border-color: var(--border-strong);
      }
      
      .param-input:focus {
        outline: none;
        border-color: var(--signal);
        box-shadow: none;
      }
      
      .param-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }
      
      .param-unit {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        color: var(--ink-faint);
      }
      
      .param-slider {
        width: 100%;
        margin-top: 0.4rem;
        accent-color: var(--signal);
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      
      .param-slider:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }
      
      .param-error {
        margin-top: 0.5rem;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--danger);
        background: var(--danger-bg);
        border: 1px solid var(--signal);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.45rem 0.65rem;
      }
      
      .param-hint {
        margin-top: 0.5rem;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        color: var(--ink-faint);
      }
      
      .param-apply {
        margin-top: 0.75rem;
        width: 100%;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--surface);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
        position: relative;
      }
      
      .param-apply:hover:not(:disabled) {
        border-color: var(--signal);
        background: var(--signal-soft);
        box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--signal);
      }
      
      .param-apply:active:not(:disabled) {
        animation: tick-settle 0.28s var(--ease-out);
      }
      
      .param-apply:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }
      
      .param-apply:not(:disabled) {
        border-color: var(--signal);
        box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--signal);
      }
      
      /* --- assembly tree --- */
      
      .assembly-root {
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.03em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
      }
      
      .inspector-empty-inline {
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        color: var(--ink-faint);
        font-weight: 500;
      }
      
      .assembly-list {
        list-style: none;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 0.25rem;
      }
      
      .assembly-list li {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto;
        gap: 0.2rem;
        align-items: center;
      }
      
      .assembly-item {
        text-align: left;
        background: var(--surface);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 0.4rem 0.55rem;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;
      }
      
      .assembly-item:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
      
      .assembly-item.selected {
        border-color: var(--signal);
        background: var(--signal-soft);
      }
      
      .assembly-item-name {
        display: block;
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        font-weight: 600;
      }
      
      .assembly-item-type {
        display: block;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 0.62rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--ink-faint);
      }
      
      .assembly-icon {
        width: 1.7rem;
        height: 1.7rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        background: var(--surface);
        border-radius: 2px;
        cursor: pointer;
        color: var(--ink-secondary);

- path: frontend\components\AccountChip.tsx
  content: |
      "use client";
      
      import Link from "next/link";
      import { useAuth } from "@/components/AuthProvider";
      
      /** Signed-in identity in the top bar, or a sign-in affordance. */
      export function AccountChip() {
        const { status, email, uid, signOut } = useAuth();
      
        if (status === "unavailable") return null;
        if (status === "loading") {
          return <span className="account-chip">Checking account…</span>;
        }
        if (status === "signed-out" || !uid) {
          return (
            <div className="account-chip" data-testid="account-signin-inline">
              <Link className="account-chip-link" href="/signin">
                Sign in
              </Link>
            </div>
          );
        }
        return (
          <div className="account-chip" data-testid="account-chip">
            <span className="account-chip-email" title={email ?? uid}>
              {email ?? uid.slice(0, 12)}
            </span>
            <button type="button" className="account-signout" onClick={() => void signOut()}>
              Sign out
            </button>
          </div>
        );
      }
      
- path: frontend\components\BootScreen.tsx
  content: |
      "use client";
      
      /**
       * Boot screen — a short initialization moment that frames CGEN as an
       * engineering system coming online. The checklist rows are honest: they
       * reflect real readiness signals (schema version constant, WebGL renderer
       * availability, backend health probe already in flight on the page).
       *
       * Never blocks: the page transitions as soon as the checks resolve, with a
       * hard cap so a slow/offline backend cannot trap the user on this screen.
       * All animation is CSS and disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
       */
      import Image from "next/image";
      import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
      import { WalkingMachine } from "./WalkingMachine";
      
      export interface BootChecks {
        /** Schema/version gate — always true when M6 code is running. */
        schema: boolean;
        /** WebGL is available for the 3D preview. */
        renderer: boolean;
        /** Backend answered the health probe (true = reachable; false = not yet). */
        engine: boolean;
      }
      
      const BOOT_STEP_MS = 220;
      /** Hard cap: never hold the user on the boot screen longer than this. */
      const BOOT_MAX_MS = 2600;
      
      interface BootScreenProps {
        checks: BootChecks;
        /** Called when the boot sequence finishes so the parent can unmount it. */
        onDone: () => void;
      }
      
      export function BootScreen({ checks, onDone }: BootScreenProps) {
        const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(0);
        const [exiting, setExiting] = useState(false);
        const [gone, setGone] = useState(false);
        const timers = useRef<number[]>([]);
      
        const allResolved =
          checks.schema && checks.renderer && checks.engine;
      
        useEffect(() => {
          const id = window.setInterval(() => {
            setRevealed((n) => Math.min(n + 1, 3));
          }, BOOT_STEP_MS);
          timers.current.push(id);
          return () => window.clearInterval(id);
        }, []);
      
        useEffect(() => {
          if (revealed >= 3 && allResolved) {
            const id = window.setTimeout(() => setExiting(true), 240);
            timers.current.push(id);
            return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
          }
          return undefined;
        }, [revealed, allResolved]);
      
        // Hard cap — boot must never trap the user.
        useEffect(() => {
          const id = window.setTimeout(() => setExiting(true), BOOT_MAX_MS);
          timers.current.push(id);
          return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
        }, []);
      
        // Fully unmount after the fade-out so the app beneath becomes interactive.
        useEffect(() => {
          if (!exiting) return undefined;
          const id = window.setTimeout(() => {
            setGone(true);
            onDone();
          }, 340);
          timers.current.push(id);
          return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
        }, [exiting, onDone]);
      
        useEffect(() => {
          const pending = timers.current;
          return () => {
            pending.forEach((id) => window.clearInterval(id));
            pending.forEach((id) => window.clearTimeout(id));
          };
        }, []);
      
        if (gone) return null;
      
        const rows: Array<{ key: keyof BootChecks; label: string }> = [
          { key: "schema", label: "SCHEMA" },
          { key: "renderer", label: "RENDERER" },
          { key: "engine", label: "GEOMETRY" },
        ];
      
        return (
          <div
            className={`boot-screen${exiting ? " boot-screen-exit" : ""}`}
            role="status"
            aria-label="CGEN initializing"
            data-testid="boot-screen"
          >
            <Image
              src="/logo-wordmark-light.png"
              alt="cgen"
              width={423}
              height={107}
              className="boot-logo"
              priority
            />
            <div className="boot-subtitle">CAD GENERATION ENGINE</div>
      
            <WalkingMachine />
      
            <div className="boot-status">INITIALIZING ENGINE</div>
            <ul className="boot-checklist">
              {rows.map((row, index) => {
                const done = index < revealed && checks[row.key];
                return (
                  <li
                    key={row.key}
                    className={`boot-row${done ? " done" : ""}`}
                    aria-hidden={index >= revealed ? "true" : undefined}
                  >
                    <span className="boot-mark" aria-hidden="true">
                      {done ? "✓" : "·"}
                    </span>
                    {row.label}
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
            <div className="boot-footer">M6 / READY</div>
          </div>
        );
      }

  content: |
      "use client";
      
      import Link from "next/link";
      import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
      import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
      import Image from "next/image";
      import { useAuth } from "@/components/AuthProvider";
      import { useProjectStore } from "@/hooks/useProjectStore";
      
      interface Starter {
        id: string;
        name: string;
        blurb: string;
      }
      
      const STARTERS: Starter[] = [
        {
          id: "enclosure",
          name: "An enclosure",
          blurb: "A case with walls, mounting holes and a lid for a board.",
        },
        {
          id: "robot",
          name: "A small robot",
          blurb: "Chassis plate, motors, wheels and a controller.",
        },
        {
          id: "bracket",
          name: "A bracket",
          blurb: "One part, from a sentence, tuned by numbers.",
        },
      ];
      
      /** First run for a new account: name the project, then walk into the bench. */
      export default function OnboardingPage() {
        const router = useRouter();
        const { status } = useAuth();
        const store = useProjectStore();
        const [step, setStep] = useState<0 | 1>(0);
        const [name, setName] = useState("");
        const [starter, setStarter] = useState<string>(STARTERS[0]!.id);
      
        useEffect(() => {
          if (status === "signed-out") router.replace("/signin?next=/onboarding");
        }, [status, router]);
      
        const start = async () => {
          const label = name.trim() || STARTERS.find((s) => s.id === starter)?.name || "My project";
          await store.startProject(label);
          router.push("/workspace");
        };
      
        return (
          <div className="onboard">
            <header className="onboard-bar">
              <Image
                src="/logo-wordmark-light.png"
                alt="cgen"
                width={423}
                height={107}
                className="brand-logo"
                priority
              />
              <span className="mono">Set up the bench</span>
              <span className="topbar-spacer" />
              <Link className="onboard-skip mono" href="/workspace">
                Skip for now
              </Link>
            </header>
      
            <ol className="onboard-steps" aria-label="Progress">
              <li className={step === 0 ? "onboard-step is-current" : "onboard-step is-done"}>
                <span className="mono">01</span> Name it
              </li>
              <li className={step === 1 ? "onboard-step is-current" : "onboard-step"}>
                <span className="mono">02</span> First part
              </li>
            </ol>
      
            {step === 0 ? (
              <section className="onboard-card">
                <h1 className="onboard-title">What are you working on?</h1>
                <p className="onboard-sub">
                  One name for this project. You can add more workspaces later.
                </p>
                <label className="onboard-field">
                  <span className="mono">Project name</span>
                  <input
                    className="object-input onboard-input"
                    value={name}
                    onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Robot chassis"
                    autoFocus
                  />
                </label>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="generate-button onboard-next"
                  onClick={() => setStep(1)}
                >
                  Continue
                </button>
              </section>
            ) : (
              <section className="onboard-card">
                <h1 className="onboard-title">Pick a starting point</h1>
                <p className="onboard-sub">
                  Just a shortcut. You can describe anything in the workspace.
                </p>
                <ul className="onboard-options">
                  {STARTERS.map((item) => (
                    <li key={item.id}>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className={
                          item.id === starter
                            ? "onboard-option is-selected"
                            : "onboard-option"
                        }
                        onClick={() => setStarter(item.id)}
                        aria-pressed={item.id === starter}
                      >
                        <span className="onboard-option-name">{item.name}</span>
                        <span className="onboard-option-blurb">{item.blurb}</span>
                      </button>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
                <div className="onboard-actions">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="onboard-back mono"
                    onClick={() => setStep(0)}
                  >
                    Back
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="generate-button onboard-next"
                    onClick={() => void start()}
                  >
                    Open the bench
                  </button>
                </div>
              </section>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      }

            )}
            {type === "cylinder" && (
              <g {...line}>
                <ellipse cx="24" cy="13" rx="13" ry="5" />
                <path d="M11 13v22c0 2.8 5.8 5 13 5s13-2.2 13-5V13" />
                <path d="M11 24c0 2.8 5.8 5 13 5s13-2.2 13-5" opacity=".45" />
              </g>
            )}
            {type === "cone" && (
              <g {...line}>
                <ellipse cx="24" cy="37" rx="13" ry="5" />
                <path d="M11 37 24 8l13 29" />
                <path d="M11 37c0 2.8 5.8 5 13 5s13-2.2 13-5" />
              </g>
            )}
            {type === "sphere" && (
              <g {...line}>
                <circle cx="24" cy="24" r="15" />
                <ellipse cx="24" cy="24" rx="15" ry="5.5" opacity=".5" />
                <ellipse cx="24" cy="24" rx="5.5" ry="15" opacity=".5" />
              </g>
            )}
            {type === "torus" && (
              <g {...line}>
                <ellipse cx="24" cy="24" rx="17" ry="10" />
                <ellipse cx="24" cy="24" rx="7" ry="4" />
              </g>
            )}
            {type === "polygon_prism" && (
              <g {...line}>
                <path d="M24 7 39 15v18L24 41 9 33V15z" />
                <path d="M9 15 24 23l15-8M24 23v18" opacity=".55" />
              </g>
            )}
            {type === "union" && (
              <g {...line}>
                <rect x="7" y="15" width="18" height="18" />
                <rect x="23" y="15" width="18" height="18" />
                <path d="M24 30v8M20 34h8" />
              </g>
            )}
            {type === "cut" && (
              <g {...line}>
                <rect x="7" y="15" width="22" height="18" />
                <circle cx="31" cy="24" r="8" strokeDasharray="3 3" />
                <path d="M18 24h12" />
              </g>
            )}
            {type === "intersect" && (
              <g {...line}>
                <circle cx="18" cy="24" r="11" />
                <circle cx="30" cy="24" r="11" />
                <path d="M24 14.5c4 5.6 4 13.4 0 19" />
              </g>
            )}
            {type === "part" && (
              <g {...line}>
                <rect x="9" y="11" width="30" height="26" rx="3" />
                <circle cx="24" cy="24" r="6.5" />
                <path d="M9 31h8" opacity=".6" />
              </g>
            )}
          </svg>
        );
      }
      
      function StackDrawing() {
        return (
          <svg
            className="lp-stack"
            viewBox="0 0 440 360"
            role="img"
            aria-label="Exploded assembly of a chassis plate, controller board, standoffs and screws"
          >
            <title>Exploded assembly</title>
            <g className="lp-stack-line">
              <path d="M86 268 232 322 356 268 210 216z" />
              <path d="M86 268v10l124 54 146-54v-10" opacity=".55" />
              <path d="M100 250 236 300 360 250 224 202z" />
              <path d="M100 250v8l124 50 136-50v-8" opacity=".45" />
              <path d="M112 226 238 272 350 226 224 182z" />
              <path d="M112 226v7l126 46 112-46v-7" opacity=".4" />
            </g>
            <g className="lp-stack-part">
              <path d="M112 226 238 272 350 226 224 182z" />
              <path d="M136 212 238 248 326 212 224 176z" opacity=".5" />
              <path d="M154 205h30v18h-30zM260 200h24v16h-24z" opacity=".65" />
              <path d="M205 190h34v12h-34z" opacity=".65" />
            </g>
            <g className="lp-stack-standoff">
              <path d="M128 246v-20M336 246v-20M154 272v-20M318 272v-20" />
              <circle cx="128" cy="226" r="3" />
              <circle cx="336" cy="226" r="3" />
              <circle cx="154" cy="252" r="3" />
              <circle cx="318" cy="252" r="3" />
            </g>
            <g className="lp-stack-screw">
              <path d="M128 198v-23M336 198v-23M154 224v-23M318 224v-23" />
              <path d="M120 175h16M328 175h16M146 201h16M310 201h16" />
              <path d="M120 168h16M328 168h16M146 194h16M310 194h16" opacity=".55" />
            </g>
            <g className="lp-stack-label">
              <path d="M224 176 224 120 286 120" />
              <text x="292" y="117">ESP32</text>
              <path d="M350 226 384 202 384 164" />
              <text x="352" y="150">CHASSIS PLATE</text>
              <path d="M336 190 384 166" />
              <text x="352" y="182">M3 × 12</text>
            </g>
          </svg>
        );
      }
      
      export default function LandingPage() {
        return (
          <div className="lp">
            <LandingPing />
            <header className="lp-bar">
              <div className="lp-bar-inner">
                <Link href="/" className="lp-brand" aria-label="cgen home">
                  <Image
                    src="/logo-wordmark-light.png"
                    alt=""
                    width={423}
                    height={107}
                    className="lp-brand-logo"
                    priority
                  />
                  <span className="lp-brand-tag mono">language → solid</span>
                </Link>
      
                <nav className="lp-nav" aria-label="Landing sections">
                  <a href="#sequence">Sequence</a>
                  <a href="#capabilities">Capabilities</a>
                  <a href="#assembly">Assembly</a>
                  <a href="#history">History</a>
                  <a href="#interface">Interface</a>
                </nav>
      
                <div className="lp-bar-actions">
                  <Link className="lp-link mono" href="/signin">
                    Sign in
                  </Link>
                  <Link className="lp-cta" href="/workspace">
                    Open the bench <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
                  </Link>
                </div>
              </div>
            </header>
            <div className="lp-tickrail" aria-hidden="true" />
      
            <main>
              <section className="lp-hero">
                <div className="lp-hero-grid">
                  <div className="lp-hero-copy">
                    <p className="lp-eyebrow mono">
                      <span className="lp-eyebrow-mark" aria-hidden="true" />
                      Language → validated solid
                    </p>
                    <h1 className="lp-h1">
                      Say the part.
                      <br />
                      Hold the solid<span className="lp-dot">.</span>
                    </h1>
                    <p className="lp-lede">
                      cgen reads a plain sentence, returns a validated CAD
                      specification, and machines it with a deterministic engine.
                      STEP and STL come out the other side — not a picture of a part,
                      the part.
                    </p>
                    <div className="lp-actions">
                      <TrackedLink
                        className="lp-cta lp-cta-lg"
                        href="/workspace"
                        event="landing_cta"
                      >
                        Start building <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
                      </TrackedLink>
                      <a className="lp-ghost mono" href="#sequence">
                        See the pipeline
                      </a>
                    </div>
                    <dl className="lp-facts">
                      {FACTS.map((fact) => (
                        <div key={fact.label} className="lp-fact">
                          <dt className="mono">{fact.label}</dt>
                          <dd>{fact.value}</dd>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </dl>
                    <p className="lp-hero-note mono">
                      No code execution · deterministic CadQuery · schema v3.2
                    </p>
                  </div>
      
                  <div className="lp-hero-instrument">
                    <SpecimenPanel />
                    <div className="lp-plate mono">
                      <span>Specimen series 01–03</span>
                      <span>not a customer file</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </section>
      
              <div className="lp-marquee" aria-hidden="true">
                <div className="lp-marquee-track mono">
                  {[0, 1].map((copy) => (
                    <span key={copy} className="lp-marquee-set">
                      <span>Schema 3.2</span>
                      <i />
                      <span>Deterministic geometry</span>
                      <i />
                      <span>No code execution</span>
                      <i />
                      <span>STEP / STL</span>
                      <i />
                      <span>Component registry</span>
                      <i />
                      <span>Append-only revisions</span>
                      <i />
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
      
              <section className="lp-section" id="sequence">
                <div className="lp-section-inner">
                  <header className="lp-section-head">
                    <p className="lp-kicker mono">01 / sequence</p>
                    <h2 className="lp-title">Four moves from sentence to solid.</h2>
                    <p className="lp-section-lede">
                      The model interprets intent. The schema checks every number.
                      The engine builds geometry. The bench keeps the record. Nothing
                      in that chain executes generated code.
                    </p>
                  </header>
      
                  <ol className="lp-sequence">
                    {STATIONS.map((station) => (
                      <li key={station.number} className="lp-station">
                        <div className="lp-station-top mono">
                          <span className="lp-station-num">{station.number}</span>
                          <span>{station.label}</span>
                        </div>
                        <h3>{station.title}</h3>
                        <p>{station.copy}</p>
                        <span className="lp-station-out mono">{station.output}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ol>
                </div>
              </section>
      
              <section className="lp-section lp-band" id="capabilities">
                <div className="lp-section-inner">
                  <header className="lp-section-head lp-split-head">
                    <div>
                      <p className="lp-kicker mono">02 / capability</p>
                      <h2 className="lp-title">A machining vocabulary, not a prompt trick.</h2>
                    </div>
                    <p className="lp-section-lede">
                      Ten primitives and boolean operations, plus the engineering
                      features that make a part manufacturable. All dimensions are
                      millimeters; operation trees are capped at depth 4 and 15
                      nodes.
                    </p>
                  </header>
      
                  <ul className="lp-tools">
                    {OPERATIONS.map((op) => (
                      <li key={op.type} className="lp-tool">
                        <OpGlyph type={op.type} />
                        <span className="lp-tool-name mono">{op.type}</span>
                        <span className="lp-tool-meta">{op.meta}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
      
                  <div className="lp-features">
                    <p className="lp-features-title mono">Engineering features</p>
                    <ul>
                      {FEATURES.map(([name, note]) => (
                        <li key={name}>
                          <span className="lp-feature-name mono">{name}</span>
                          <span className="lp-feature-note">{note}</span>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </section>
      
              <section className="lp-section" id="assembly">
                <div className="lp-section-inner lp-assembly">
                  <div className="lp-assembly-copy">
                    <p className="lp-kicker mono">03 / assembly</p>
                    <h2 className="lp-title">A parts bin that never calls the model.</h2>
                    <p className="lp-section-lede">
                      Pull an ESP32, a servo, an M3 screw or a chassis plate from the
                      registry. Add, move, hide and re-parameterize without a prompt.
                      Repeated fasteners are one definition with N poses.
                    </p>
      
                    <ul className="lp-library">
                      {LIBRARY.map(([name, count, note]) => (
                        <li key={name}>
                          <span className="lp-library-name mono">{name}</span>
                          <span className="lp-library-count mono">{count}</span>
                          <span className="lp-library-note">{note}</span>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
      
                    <div className="lp-zero">
                      <span className="lp-zero-number">0</span>
                      <span className="lp-zero-copy">
                        LLM calls for library inserts, placement, visibility and
                        numeric rebuilds.
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
      
                  <figure className="lp-assembly-visual">
                    <div className="lp-visual-bar mono">
                      <span>Assembly 04</span>
                      <span>exploded / 6 parts</span>
                    </div>
                    <StackDrawing />
                    <figcaption className="lp-visual-note mono">
                      Objects stay separate in the scene; exports pass a compound,
                      not a boolean union.
                    </figcaption>
                  </figure>
                </div>
              </section>
      
              <section className="lp-section lp-band" id="history">
                <div className="lp-section-inner">
                  <header className="lp-section-head lp-split-head">
                    <div>
                      <p className="lp-kicker mono">04 / ledger</p>
                      <h2 className="lp-title">The ledger never erases.</h2>
                    </div>
                    <p className="lp-section-lede">
                      Every successful generate, modify, assembly edit and numeric
                      adjustment appends a revision. Step back to any earlier state,
                      branch a new child from it, and nothing is destroyed.
                    </p>
                  </header>
      
                  <div className="lp-ledger-wrap">
                    <ol className="lp-ledger">
                      {LEDGER.map((row) => (
                        <li key={row.rev} className="lp-ledger-row">
                          <span className="lp-rev mono">{row.rev}</span>
                          <span className="lp-kind mono">{row.kind}</span>
                          <span className="lp-prompt">{row.prompt}</span>
                          <span className="lp-digest mono">{row.digest}</span>
                          <span className="lp-time mono">{row.time}</span>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                      <li className="lp-ledger-row lp-ledger-branch">
                        <span className="lp-rev mono">REV 04b</span>
                        <span className="lp-kind mono">Branch</span>
                        <span className="lp-prompt">
                          Re-open revision 04 and retune the wall without touching 05
                          or 06
                        </span>
                        <span className="lp-digest mono">sha a14e08</span>
                        <span className="lp-time mono">10:37</span>
                      </li>
                    </ol>
      
                    <aside className="lp-ledger-aside">
                      <p className="lp-aside-title mono">Retention</p>
                      <p>
                        File links expire on ephemeral storage. Specifications do
                        not. One click re-mints STEP and STL from the stored spec —
                        no model call, no diff guard, no lost revision.
                      </p>
                      <p className="lp-aside-note mono">
                        Links ≈ 1 h · specs permanent
                      </p>
                    </aside>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </section>
      
              <section className="lp-section" id="interface">
                <div className="lp-section-inner">
                  <header className="lp-section-head">
                    <p className="lp-kicker mono">05 / interface</p>
                    <h2 className="lp-title">Structured data in. Real files out.</h2>
                    <p className="lp-section-lede">
                      A small HTTP surface with deterministic routes for the work
                      that should never touch the model. Errors are controlled;
                      secrets, paths and tracebacks stay in the server logs.
                    </p>
                  </header>
      
                  <div className="lp-endpoints mono">
                    <span>POST /generate</span>
                    <span>POST /modify</span>
                    <span>POST /rebuild</span>
                    <span>POST /remint</span>
                    <span>POST /assembly/*</span>
                    <span>GET /download/&#123;token&#125;</span>
                  </div>
      
                  <div className="lp-code-grid">
                    <div className="lp-code">
                      <div className="lp-code-bar mono">
                        <span>request.json</span>
                        <span>POST /generate</span>
                      </div>
                      <pre className="lp-code-body">
                        <code>{`{
        `}<span className="lp-c-key">&quot;prompt&quot;</span>{`: `}<span className="lp-c-str">&quot;An L-bracket, 90 by 70 by 60 mm,
        with four Ø5 holes.&quot;</span>{`
      }`}</code>
                      </pre>
                    </div>
      
                    <div className="lp-code">
                      <div className="lp-code-bar mono">
                        <span>response.json</span>
                        <span>200 · completed</span>
                      </div>
                      <pre className="lp-code-body">
                        <code>{`{
        `}<span className="lp-c-key">&quot;status&quot;</span>{`: `}<span className="lp-c-str">&quot;completed&quot;</span>{`,
        `}<span className="lp-c-key">&quot;specification&quot;</span>{`: {
          `}<span className="lp-c-key">&quot;document_type&quot;</span>{`: `}<span className="lp-c-str">&quot;3d_part&quot;</span>{`,
          `}<span className="lp-c-key">&quot;units&quot;</span>{`: `}<span className="lp-c-str">&quot;mm&quot;</span>{`,
          `}<span className="lp-c-key">&quot;operation&quot;</span>{`: { `}<span className="lp-c-str">&quot;type&quot;</span>{`: `}<span className="lp-c-str">&quot;part&quot;</span>{` }
        },
        `}<span className="lp-c-key">&quot;files&quot;</span>{`: {
          `}<span className="lp-c-key">&quot;step&quot;</span>{`: `}<span className="lp-c-str">&quot;/download/…&quot;</span>{`,
          `}<span className="lp-c-key">&quot;stl&quot;</span>{`: `}<span className="lp-c-str">&quot;/download/…&quot;</span>{`
        }
      }`}</code>
                      </pre>
                    </div>
                  </div>
      
                  <ul className="lp-stats">
                    {STATS.map(([number, label]) => (
                      <li key={label} className="lp-stat">
                        <span className="lp-stat-number mono">{number}</span>
                        <span className="lp-stat-label mono">{label}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              </section>
      
              <section className="lp-section lp-band" id="notes">
                <div className="lp-section-inner lp-notes">
                  <header className="lp-section-head">
                    <p className="lp-kicker mono">06 / notes</p>

                    <p className="lp-section-lede">
                      Honest limits, quick answers, and the parts that are
                      deliberately out of scope.
                    </p>
                  </header>
      
                  <div className="lp-faq">
                    {FAQ.map((item, index) => (
                      <details
                        key={item.q}
