                      >
                        <summary className="lp-faq-q">
                          <span className="lp-faq-index mono">
                            {String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
                          </span>
                          <span>{item.q}</span>
                          <span className="lp-faq-mark" aria-hidden="true">
                            +
                          </span>
                        </summary>
                        <p className="lp-faq-a">{item.a}</p>
                      </details>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </section>
      
              <section className="lp-close">
                <div className="lp-close-inner">
                  <p className="lp-kicker mono">07 / the bench</p>
                  <h2 className="lp-close-title">
                    Bring a part
                    <br />
                    to the bench<span className="lp-dot">.</span>
                  </h2>
                  <p className="lp-close-sub">
                    Describe it plainly. Adjust it numerically. Download the solid.
                    No account required to start.
                  </p>
                  <div className="lp-actions">
                    <TrackedLink
                      className="lp-cta lp-cta-lg"
                      href="/workspace"
                      event="landing_cta"
                    >
                      Open the bench <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
                    </TrackedLink>
                    <Link className="lp-ghost mono" href="/signin">
                      Create an account
                    </Link>
                  </div>
                  <p className="lp-close-coords mono">
                    X 000.00 · Y 000.00 · Z 000.00 ·<span> ready</span>
                  </p>
                </div>
              </section>
            </main>
      
            <footer className="lp-foot">
              <div className="lp-foot-inner">
                <div className="lp-foot-brand">
                  <div className="lp-foot-mark">
                    <Image
                      src="/logo-wordmark-light.png"
                      alt="cgen"
                      width={423}
                      height={107}
                      className="lp-brand-logo"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <p>Language to solid. Built on CadQuery, kept in revisions.</p>
                </div>
      
                <nav className="lp-foot-col" aria-label="Bench">
                  <p className="lp-foot-title mono">Bench</p>
                  <Link href="/workspace">Open workspace</Link>
                  <Link href="/signin">Sign in</Link>
                  <a href="#history">Revision ledger</a>
                </nav>
      
                <nav className="lp-foot-col" aria-label="Reference">
                  <p className="lp-foot-title mono">Reference</p>
                  <a href="#sequence">Pipeline</a>
                  <a href="#capabilities">Operations</a>
                  <a href="#interface">API surface</a>
                </nav>
      
                <nav className="lp-foot-col" aria-label="Legal">
                  <p className="lp-foot-title mono">Project</p>
                  <a href="#notes">Limits &amp; notes</a>
                  <a href="#assembly">Component registry</a>
                  <Link href="/privacy">Privacy</Link>
                  <Link href="/terms">Terms</Link>
                  <Link href="/workspace">Try without an account</Link>
                </nav>
              </div>
      
              <div className="lp-foot-bottom mono">
                <span>cgen · MIT · schema 3.2</span>
                <span>Precision Bench / 2026</span>
              </div>
            </footer>
          </div>
        );
      }
      
- path: frontend\app\layout.tsx
  content: |
      import type { Metadata, Viewport } from "next";
      import { AuthProvider } from "@/components/AuthProvider";
      import { TelemetryBridge } from "@/components/TelemetryBridge";
      import "./globals.css";
      import "./landing.css";
      
      /** Canonical origin for absolute URLs in metadata. Baked in at build time. */
      const SITE_URL = (
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL ?? "https://cgen.pxxl.click"
      ).replace(/\/+$/, "");
      
      const TITLE = "cgen — language to solid";
      const DESCRIPTION =
        "Describe a part in plain language and get validated STEP and STL CAD files from a deterministic CadQuery engine. No code execution, append-only revisions.";
      
      export const metadata: Metadata = {
        metadataBase: new URL(SITE_URL),
        title: {
          default: TITLE,
          template: "%s · cgen",
        },
        description: DESCRIPTION,
        applicationName: "cgen",
        alternates: { canonical: "/" },
        /* Both icons are plain static files in public/ — no app/ metadata routes, so
           nothing runs image processing at request time in production. */
        icons: { icon: "/favicon.ico", apple: "/apple-touch-icon.png" },
        /* Launch posts unfurl from these. The image is a static 1200×630 card built
           by scripts/make-og.js, so no OG image route runs at request time. */
        openGraph: {
          type: "website",
          url: "/",
          siteName: "cgen",
          title: TITLE,
          description: DESCRIPTION,
          images: [
            {
              url: "/og.png",
              width: 1200,
              height: 630,
              alt: "cgen — describe a part, download STEP + STL",
            },
          ],
        },
        twitter: {
          card: "summary_large_image",
          title: TITLE,
          description: DESCRIPTION,
          images: ["/og.png"],
        },
      };
      
      export const viewport: Viewport = {
        width: "device-width",
        initialScale: 1,
        themeColor: "#0e1014",
      };
      
      export default function RootLayout({
        children,
      }: Readonly<{
        children: React.ReactNode;
      }>) {
        return (
          <html lang="en">
            <head>
              <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
              <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossOrigin="anonymous" />
              <link
                href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Semi+Condensed:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap"
                rel="stylesheet"
              />
            </head>
            <body>
              <TelemetryBridge />
              <AuthProvider>{children}</AuthProvider>
            </body>
          </html>
        );
      }
      
- path: frontend\app\not-found.tsx
  content: |
      import Link from "next/link";
      
      /** Custom 404. Next's default is an unstyled page that looks like a different
       *  product, which is exactly the wrong note on a launch-day dead link. */
      export default function NotFound() {
        return (
          <main className="legal">
            <div className="legal-inner">
              <p className="legal-eyebrow mono">
                <Link href="/">← cgen</Link>
                <span>404</span>
              </p>
      
              <h1>No such page.</h1>
              <p className="legal-lede">
                The address you followed does not exist in this deployment. It may have
                been renamed, or a link may have been mistyped.
              </p>
      
              <div className="legal-actions">
                <Link className="lp-cta" href="/">
                  Back to the bench <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
                </Link>
                <Link className="lp-ghost mono" href="/workspace">
                  Open the workspace
                </Link>
              </div>
      
              <p className="legal-foot mono">
                <span>cgen · language to solid</span>
                <Link href="/terms">Terms →</Link>
              </p>
            </div>
          </main>
        );
      }
      
- path: frontend\app\error.tsx
  content: |
      "use client";
      
      import { useEffect } from "react";
      import Link from "next/link";
      import { reportError } from "@/lib/telemetry";
      
      /** Route-level error boundary. Next renders this instead of a blank screen
       *  when a page throws during render, and the error is reported so a launch-day
       *  crash is visible on the server rather than only in one visitor's console. */
      export default function RouteError({
        error,
        reset,
      }: {
        error: Error & { digest?: string };
        reset: () => void;
      }) {
        useEffect(() => {
          reportError(error, "route-error");
        }, [error]);
      
        return (
          <main className="legal">
            <div className="legal-inner">
              <p className="legal-eyebrow mono">
                <span>Error</span>
                <span>{error.digest ?? "unhandled"}</span>
              </p>
      
              <h1>That page failed to render.</h1>
              <p className="legal-lede">
                The error was logged. Retrying usually clears it; if it keeps
                happening, the workspace data for this page may be the cause.
              </p>
      
              <div className="legal-actions">
                <button type="button" className="lp-cta" onClick={() => reset()}>
                  Try again
                </button>
                <Link className="lp-ghost mono" href="/">
                  Back to the bench
                </Link>
              </div>
            </div>
          </main>
        );
      }

      type PageStatus = "idle" | "generating" | "ready" | "error";
      type AppView = "home" | "workspace";
      
      interface PlacementDraft {
        name: string;
        position: [number, number, number];
        rotation: [number, number, number];
        instances: Array<{
          position: [number, number, number];
          rotation: [number, number, number];
        }>;

      const MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH = 2000;
      
      function detectWebgl(): boolean {
        try {
          const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
          return Boolean(
            canvas.getContext("webgl2") ??
              canvas.getContext("webgl") ??
              canvas.getContext("experimental-webgl"),
          );
        } catch {

      }
      
      export default function Home() {
        const [view, setView] = useState<AppView>("home");
        const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState("");
        const [status, setStatus] = useState<PageStatus>("idle");
        // Project → Workspace → Revision model: revisions are append-only, so a
        // generate/modify never destroys previous specs. The viewer shows the
        // visible (active, non-cleared) revision of the active workspace.
        const [project, setProject] = useState<Project>(() => ({
          id: "project-initial",
          name: "Mechanical Bracket",
          workspaces: [
            {
              id: "workspace-initial",
              name: "Workspace 1",
              revisions: [],
              activeRevisionId: null,
              viewerCleared: false,
            },
          ],
          activeWorkspaceId: "workspace-initial",
        }));
        const [generateError, setGenerateError] = useState<string | null>(null);
        const [previewError, setPreviewError] = useState<string | null>(null);
        const [booting, setBooting] = useState(true);
        const [bootChecks, setBootChecks] = useState<BootChecks>({
          schema: false,
          renderer: false,
          engine: false,
        });
        const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
        const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
        const [catalog, setCatalog] = useState<CatalogComponent[]>([]);
        const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
        const [selectedInstance, setSelectedInstance] = useState(-1);
        const [visibilityDraft, setVisibilityDraft] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>(

        // Placement is a draft until Apply. Keeping it per object is what makes a

        const [placementDrafts, setPlacementDrafts] = useState<

        const [draftParams, setDraftParams] = useState<Record<string, ParamValue>>({});
        const [draftInstances, setDraftInstances] = useState<

        const [moving, setMoving] = useState(false);
        const [moveOrigin, setMoveOrigin] = useState<{

          instances: Array<{

            rotation: [number, number, number];
          }>;

        // `moveOrigin` state update. The ref is the synchronous read path so the
        // final delta of a drag is never dropped and the object never snaps back.
        const moveOriginRef = useRef(moveOrigin);
        useEffect(() => {
          moveOriginRef.current = moveOrigin;
        }, [moveOrigin]);
        const selectedInstanceRef = useRef(selectedInstance);
        useEffect(() => {
          selectedInstanceRef.current = selectedInstance;
        }, [selectedInstance]);
      
        const clearDrafts = useCallback(() => {
          setPlacementDrafts({});

        }, []);

        const firestoreDb = useFirestore();
        const { uid } = useProjectSync(project, setProject, firestoreDb, clearDrafts);
        const [homeNotice, setHomeNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
      
        useEffect(() => {

            .then((data) => {
              if (!cancelled) setCatalog(data.components);
            })

            });

        useEffect(() => {

        }, []);

        useEffect(() => {

        }, []);
      
        const activeWorkspace = useMemo(() => getActiveWorkspace(project), [project]);
        const visible = useMemo(
          () => visibleRevision(activeWorkspace),
          [activeWorkspace],
        );
        const result = visible?.response ?? null;
        const baseSpec = visible?.response.specification ?? null;
      
        // M8.1 parametric session: edits are transient UI values; preview is the
        // last successful rebuild (never a revision); committing appends exactly
        // one revision. Everything resets when the visible revision changes.
        const paramSession = useParametricSession(baseSpec);
        const {

        // stale/invalid the last good preview (or base) stays — never a jump.
        const displayResult =
          !editsActive

        const baseObjects: SceneObject[] = useMemo(() => {
          if (!displayResult) return [];
          return sceneObjects(displayResult, resolveFileUrl, catalog);
        }, [displayResult, catalog]);
      
        // Displayed scene = committed spec + every object's uncommitted placement
        // and visibility draft. Drafts are no longer tied to the current selection.
        const objects: SceneObject[] = useMemo(() => {
          return baseObjects.map((object) => {
            const placement = placementDrafts[object.id];
            const vis = visibilityDraft[object.id];
            if (placement === undefined && vis === undefined) return object;
            return {
              ...object,
              ...(placement === undefined
                ? {}
                : {
                    name: placement.name,
                    transform: {
                      position: placement.position,
                      rotation: placement.rotation,
                    },
                    instances: placement.instances,
                  }),
              ...(vis === undefined ? {} : { visible: vis }),
            };
          });
        }, [baseObjects, placementDrafts, visibilityDraft]);
      
        const activeSelectedId =
          selectedId !== null && objects.some((o) => o.id === selectedId)
            ? selectedId
            : null;
        // Dirty checks compare the draft against the committed object; the inspector
        // renders the draft-overlaid one.
        const selectedBase = useMemo(
          () => baseObjects.find((o) => o.id === activeSelectedId) ?? null,
          [baseObjects, activeSelectedId],
        );
        const selectedObject = useMemo(
          () => objects.find((o) => o.id === activeSelectedId) ?? null,
          [objects, activeSelectedId],
        );
      
        const instancesDirty = useMemo(() => {
          if (selectedBase === null) return false;
          if (draftInstances.length === 0 && selectedBase.instances.length === 0) {
            return false;
          }
          return JSON.stringify(draftInstances) !== JSON.stringify(selectedBase.instances);
        }, [selectedBase, draftInstances]);
      
        const placementDirty = useMemo(() => {
          if (selectedBase === null) return false;
          const visChanged = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
            visibilityDraft,
            selectedBase.id,
          );
          return (
            draftName !== selectedBase.name ||
            draftPosition[0] !== selectedBase.transform.position[0] ||
            draftPosition[1] !== selectedBase.transform.position[1] ||
            draftPosition[2] !== selectedBase.transform.position[2] ||
            draftRotation[0] !== selectedBase.transform.rotation[0] ||
            draftRotation[1] !== selectedBase.transform.rotation[1] ||
            draftRotation[2] !== selectedBase.transform.rotation[2] ||
            instancesDirty ||
            visChanged
          );
        }, [
          selectedBase,
          draftName,
          draftPosition,
          draftRotation,
          instancesDirty,
          visibilityDraft,
        ]);
      
        const paramsDirty = useMemo(() => {
          if (selectedBase === null) return false;
          return JSON.stringify(draftParams) !== JSON.stringify(selectedBase.parameters);
        }, [selectedBase, draftParams]);
      
        /** Keep the scene-level draft in sync with an edit to the selected object. */
        const rememberPlacement = useCallback(
          (id: string, patch: Partial<PlacementDraft>) => {

              const shown = objects.find((object) => object.id === id);
              if (shown === undefined) return prev;
              const current: PlacementDraft = prev[id] ?? {
                name: shown.name,
                position: shown.transform.position,
                rotation: shown.transform.rotation,
                instances: shown.instances,

              return { ...prev, [id]: { ...current, ...patch } };
            });
          },
          [objects],
        );
      
        const forgetDraft = useCallback((id: string) => {
          setPlacementDrafts((prev) => {
            if (!(id in prev)) return prev;
            const next = { ...prev };
            delete next[id];
            return next;
          });
          setVisibilityDraft((prev) => {
            if (!(id in prev)) return prev;
            const next = { ...prev };
            delete next[id];
            return next;
          });
        }, []);
      
        const handleMoveStart = useCallback(() => {
          if (selectedObject === null) return;

            instances: draftInstances.map((inst) => ({

              rotation: [...inst.rotation] as [number, number, number],

          setMoveOrigin(origin);

        const handleMoveDelta = useCallback(
          (delta: [number, number, number]) => {
            const origin = moveOriginRef.current;
            if (origin === null) return;
            const active = selectedInstanceRef.current;
            const activeId = activeSelectedId;
            // A specific instance of a repeated component moves alone; otherwise the
            // whole component (its transform plus every instance) moves as one.
            if (active >= 0) {
              const index = Math.min(active, origin.instances.length - 1);
              if (index < 0) return;
              const nextInstances = origin.instances.map((inst, i) =>
                i === index
                  ? {
                      position: [
                        inst.position[0] + delta[0],
                        inst.position[1] + delta[1],
                        inst.position[2] + delta[2],
                      ] as [number, number, number],
                      rotation: inst.rotation,
                    }
                  : inst,
              );
              setDraftInstances(nextInstances);
              if (activeId !== null) {
                rememberPlacement(activeId, { instances: nextInstances });
              }
              return;
            }
            const nextPosition: [number, number, number] = [
              origin.position[0] + delta[0],
              origin.position[1] + delta[1],
              origin.position[2] + delta[2],
            ];
            setDraftPosition(nextPosition);
            const nextInstances =
              origin.instances.length > 0
                ? origin.instances.map((inst) => ({
                    position: [
                      inst.position[0] + delta[0],
                      inst.position[1] + delta[1],
                      inst.position[2] + delta[2],
                    ] as [number, number, number],
                    rotation: inst.rotation,

                : [];
            if (nextInstances.length > 0) setDraftInstances(nextInstances);
            if (activeId !== null) {

                position: nextPosition,
                ...(nextInstances.length > 0 ? { instances: nextInstances } : {}),

            }
          },
          [activeSelectedId, rememberPlacement],
        );
      
        const handleMoveEnd = useCallback(() => {
          setMoving(false);
          setMoveOrigin(null);
        }, []);
      
        // Instant dial feedback: scale the currently displayed mesh toward the
        // edited spec while a rebuild is pending. Cleared when the preview lands
        // (geometry already matches) so the authoritative mesh is unscaled.
        const liveScale = useMemo(() => {
          if (!editsActive || editedSpec === null || displayResult === null) return null;
          return computeLiveScale(displayResult.specification, editedSpec);
        }, [editsActive, editedSpec, displayResult]);

          abortRef.current?.abort();

          setStatus("generating");
          setGenerateError(null);
          setPreviewError(null);
          track("generate_started");
          try {
            const text = prompt.trim();
            const response = await generatePart(text, controller.signal);
            setProject((p) => appendRevision(p, "generate", text, response));
            setStatus("ready");
            clearDrafts();
            track("generate_completed");
          } catch (err) {
            if (err instanceof DOMException && err.name === "AbortError") return;
            track("generate_failed");
            setGenerateError(humanizeApiError(err as ApiError));
            setStatus("error");
          }
        }, [prompt, status, clearDrafts]);
      
        const handleModify = useCallback(async () => {
          if (status === "generating" || visible === null) return;
          if (prompt.trim().length === 0) {
            setGenerateError("Describe the modification \u2014 the prompt is empty.");
            setStatus("error");
            return;
          }
          abortRef.current?.abort();
          const controller = new AbortController();
          abortRef.current = controller;
          setStatus("generating");
          setGenerateError(null);
          setPreviewError(null);
          track("modify_started");
          try {
            const text = prompt.trim();
            const response = await modifyPart(
              visible.response.specification as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
              text,
              controller.signal,
            );

            setStatus("ready");
            clearDrafts();
            track("modify_completed");
          } catch (err) {
            if (err instanceof DOMException && err.name === "AbortError") return;
            track("modify_failed");
            setGenerateError(humanizeApiError(err as ApiError));
            setStatus("error");
          }
        }, [prompt, status, visible, clearDrafts]);
      
        const handleParamCommit = useCallback(async () => {
          if (status === "generating") return;
          const done = await paramSession.commit();
          if (done !== null) {
            setProject((p) => appendRevision(p, "adjust", done.summary, done.response));
          }
        }, [paramSession, status]);
      
        // One-click file revival: an old revision's spec is re-exported as-is for
        // fresh download links. No AI, no edits — the new revision keeps the same
        // spec with new file URLs, so history stays append-only and honest.
        const handleRemint = useCallback(async () => {

          const spec = visible.response.specification as unknown as Record<
            string,

          >;

          abortRef.current = controller;

          setGenerateError(null);
          setPreviewError(null);

            setProject((p) => appendRevision(p, "remint", "Re-mint files", response));
            setStatus("ready");
          } catch (err) {

            setGenerateError(humanizeApiError(err as ApiError));
            setStatus("error");
          }
        }, [status, visible]);

        // is gone (backend restart, another deployment), so opening it 404s. The
        // spec is authoritative, so re-mint fresh files once per workspace instead

        useExpiredFileRevival(

          activeWorkspace.id,

        );

          async (label: string, work: () => Promise<GenerateResponse>): Promise<boolean> => {

            abortRef.current = controller;
            setStatus("generating");
            setGenerateError(null);
            try {
              const response = await work();
              setProject((p) => appendRevision(p, "assemble", label, response));
              setStatus("ready");
              return true;
            } catch (err) {
              if (err instanceof DOMException && err.name === "AbortError") return false;
              setGenerateError(humanizeApiError(err as ApiError));
              setStatus("error");
              return false;
            }

        );
      
        const handleAddComponent = useCallback(
          (type: string, count = 1) => {
            void commitAssembly(`Add ${type}`, () =>

            );

        );
      
        const handleRemoveComponent = useCallback(
          (id: string) => {
            const spec = specRecord();
            if (spec === null) return;
            void commitAssembly(`Remove ${id}`, () =>
              removeAssemblyComponent(spec, id, abortRef.current?.signal),
            );
          },

        );
      
        const handleToggleVisible = useCallback((id: string) => {
          setVisibilityDraft((prev) => {
            const current = objects.find((o) => o.id === id);
            const shown = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(prev, id)
              ? prev[id]
              : (current?.visible ?? true);
            return { ...prev, [id]: !shown };
          });
        }, [objects]);

        // fields and the gizmo always manipulate the same thing.
        const editPosition = draftInstances[selectedInstance]?.position;
        const shownPosition: [number, number, number] =
          selectedInstance >= 0 && editPosition ? editPosition : draftPosition;
      
        const handleEditPosition = useCallback(
          (axis: 0 | 1 | 2, value: number) => {
            const active = selectedInstanceRef.current;
            const activeId = activeSelectedId;
            if (active >= 0) {
              const nextInstances = draftInstances.map((inst, i) =>
                i === active
                  ? {
                      position: [
                        inst.position[0],
                        inst.position[1],
                        inst.position[2],
                      ].map((v, ax) => (ax === axis ? value : v)) as [
                        number,
                        number,
                        number,
                      ],
                      rotation: inst.rotation,
                    }
                  : inst,
              );
              setDraftInstances(nextInstances);
              if (activeId !== null) {
                rememberPlacement(activeId, { instances: nextInstances });
              }
              return;
            }
            const next: [number, number, number] = [...draftPosition];
            next[axis] = value;
            setDraftPosition(next);
            if (activeId !== null) rememberPlacement(activeId, { position: next });
          },
          [activeSelectedId, draftInstances, draftPosition, rememberPlacement],
        );
      
        const handleEditRotation = useCallback(
          (axis: 0 | 1 | 2, value: number) => {
            const next: [number, number, number] = [...draftRotation];
            next[axis] = value;
            setDraftRotation(next);
            if (activeSelectedId !== null) {
              rememberPlacement(activeSelectedId, { rotation: next });
            }
          },
          [activeSelectedId, draftRotation, rememberPlacement],
        );
      
        const handleNameChange = useCallback(
          (value: string) => {
            setDraftName(value);
            if (activeSelectedId !== null) {
              rememberPlacement(activeSelectedId, { name: value });
            }
          },
          [activeSelectedId, rememberPlacement],
        );
      
        const handleApplyPlacement = useCallback(() => {
          const spec = specRecord();
          if (spec === null || activeSelectedId === null) return;
          const id = activeSelectedId;
          const vis = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(visibilityDraft, id)
            ? visibilityDraft[id]
            : selectedObject?.visible;
          void commitAssembly(`Place ${id}`, () =>
            updateAssemblyComponent(
              spec,
              id,
              {
                name: draftName,
                transform: { position: draftPosition, rotation: draftRotation },
                visible: vis,
                ...(draftInstances.length > 0 ? { instances: draftInstances } : {}),
                // Apply is one explicit commit: include the parameter draft too.
                ...(paramsDirty ? { parameters: draftParams } : {}),
              },
              abortRef.current?.signal,
            ),
          ).then((ok) => {
            if (ok) forgetDraft(id);
          });
        }, [
          specRecord,
          activeSelectedId,
          selectedObject,
          draftName,
          draftPosition,
          draftRotation,
          draftInstances,
          paramsDirty,
          draftParams,
          visibilityDraft,
          commitAssembly,
          forgetDraft,
        ]);
      
        const handleApplyParams = useCallback(() => {
          const spec = specRecord();
          if (spec === null || activeSelectedId === null) return;
          const id = activeSelectedId;
          const vis = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(visibilityDraft, id)
            ? visibilityDraft[id]
            : selectedObject?.visible;
          void commitAssembly(`Edit ${id}`, () =>
            updateAssemblyComponent(
              spec,
              id,
              {
                parameters: draftParams,
                // Commit the visible placement too, so applying parameters cannot
                // silently discard an unsaved move.
                name: draftName,
                transform: { position: draftPosition, rotation: draftRotation },
                visible: vis,
                ...(draftInstances.length > 0 ? { instances: draftInstances } : {}),
              },
              abortRef.current?.signal,
            ),
          ).then((ok) => {
            if (ok) forgetDraft(id);
          });
        }, [
          specRecord,
          activeSelectedId,
          selectedObject,
          draftName,
          draftPosition,
          draftRotation,
          draftInstances,
          draftParams,
          visibilityDraft,
          commitAssembly,
          forgetDraft,
        ]);
      
        const handleNewWorkspace = useCallback(() => {
          setProject((p) => addWorkspace(p, `Workspace ${p.workspaces.length + 1}`));
          setHomeNotice(null);
          setPrompt("");
          setGenerateError(null);
          setPreviewError(null);
          setStatus("idle");
          clearDrafts();
          setView("workspace");
        }, [clearDrafts]);
      
        /**
         * Remove a workspace from the bench. Signed-in users get the plate flagged in
         * Firestore first: if that write fails the plate stays, so the list never
         * disagrees with what a reload will show.
         */
        const handleDeleteWorkspace = useCallback(
          (workspaceId: string) => {
            if (firestoreDb === null || uid === null) {
              setProject((p) => removeWorkspace(p, workspaceId));
              setHomeNotice(null);
              return;
            }
            void deleteWorkspaceRecord(firestoreDb, uid, project.id, workspaceId)
              .then(() => {
                setProject((p) => removeWorkspace(p, workspaceId));
                setHomeNotice(null);
              })
              .catch(() => {
                setHomeNotice("That workspace could not be removed. Nothing was changed.");
              });
          },
          [firestoreDb, uid, project.id],
        );
      
        const handleOpenWorkspace = useCallback(
          (workspaceId: string) => {
            // Compute outside the state updater: updaters must stay pure, and React
            // may run them twice in development.
            const next = switchWorkspace(project, workspaceId);
            const target = getActiveWorkspace(next);
            setProject(next);
            setHomeNotice(null);
            setGenerateError(null);
            setPreviewError(null);
            setStatus(visibleRevision(target) === null ? "idle" : "ready");
            clearDrafts();
            setView("workspace");
          },
          [project, clearDrafts],
        );
      
        const handleGoHome = useCallback(() => {
          abortRef.current?.abort();
          setView("home");
          setGenerateError(null);
          setPreviewError(null);
        }, []);
      
        const handleClearViewer = useCallback(() => {
          abortRef.current?.abort();
          setProject((p) => clearViewer(p));
          setGenerateError(null);
          setPreviewError(null);
          setStatus("idle");
          clearDrafts();
        }, [clearDrafts]);
      
        const handleSelectRevision = useCallback(
          (revisionId: string) => {
            setProject((p) => selectRevision(p, revisionId));
            setGenerateError(null);
            setPreviewError(null);
            setStatus("ready");
            clearDrafts();
            track("revision_selected");
          },
          [clearDrafts],
        );
      
        const handlePreviewStatus = useCallback(
          (state: PreviewState, message?: string) => {
            if (state === "error") {
              setPreviewError(
                message ?? "The preview mesh could not be loaded. Downloads still work.",
              );
            } else if (state === "loading") {
              setPreviewError(null);
            }
          },
          [],
        );
      
        const handleBootDone = useCallback(() => setBooting(false), []);
      
        const handlePromptKeyDown = useCallback(
          (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
            if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === "Enter") {
              e.preventDefault();
              if (visible !== null) {
                handleModify();
              } else {
                handleGenerate();
              }
            }
          },
          [handleGenerate, handleModify, visible],
        );
      
        const busy = status === "generating";
      
        if (view === "home") {
          return (
            <>
              {booting ? (
                <BootScreen checks={bootChecks} onDone={handleBootDone} />
              ) : null}
              <WorkspaceHome
                project={project}
                busy={busy}
                notice={homeNotice}
                onOpen={handleOpenWorkspace}
                onCreate={handleNewWorkspace}
                onDelete={handleDeleteWorkspace}
              />
            </>
          );
        }
      
        return (
          <div className="workspace" data-moving={moving ? "" : undefined}>
            {booting ? (
              <BootScreen checks={bootChecks} onDone={handleBootDone} />
            ) : null}
      
            <header className="topbar">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="brand"
                onClick={handleGoHome}
                title="Back to workspace shelf"
                aria-label="Back to workspace shelf"
              >
                <Image
                  src="/logo-wordmark-light.png"
                  alt="cgen"
                  width={423}
                  height={107}
                  className="brand-logo"
                  priority
                />
              </button>
      
              <span className="topbar-spacer" />
      
              <AccountChip />
      
              <button
                className="session-action"
                onClick={handleGoHome}
                disabled={busy}
                title="Back to the workspace shelf"
              >
                Workspace
              </button>
              <button
                className="session-action"
                onClick={handleClearViewer}
                disabled={busy || visible === null}
                title="Remove the displayed result; project, workspace and revisions are kept"
              >
                Clear viewer
              </button>
            </header>
      
            <main className="layout">
              <aside className="library-rail" aria-label="Model library">
                <ComponentBrowser
                  catalog={catalog}
                  busy={busy}
                  onAdd={handleAddComponent}
                />
              </aside>
              <div className="workspace-main">
                <CadViewport
                  objects={objects.map((object) => {
                    const isSel = object.id === activeSelectedId;
                    // While the gizmo drags, the attached group holds the live
                    // offset. Freeze the mesh at the drag origin for that frame; the
                    // final pose is already in the object's draft.
                    const frozen = isSel && moving ? moveOrigin : null;
                    return {
                      id: object.id,
                      url: object.stlUrl ?? "",
                      position:
                        frozen === null ? object.transform.position : frozen.position,
                      rotation:
                        frozen === null ? object.transform.rotation : draftRotation,
                      visible: object.visible && Boolean(object.stlUrl),
                      selected: isSel,
                      instances: frozen === null ? object.instances : frozen.instances,
                      activeInstanceIndex: isSel ? selectedInstance : -1,
                      recenter:
                        displayResult !== null &&
                        isPartSpec(displayResult.specification),
                    };
                  })}
                  busy={busy}
                  previewError={previewError}
                  onPreviewStatus={handlePreviewStatus}
                  onSelectExample={setPrompt}
                  onSelectObject={handleSelectObject}
                  liveScale={liveScale}
                  canDrag={!busy && activeSelectedId !== null}
                  onMoveStart={handleMoveStart}
                  onMoveDelta={handleMoveDelta}
                  onMoveEnd={handleMoveEnd}
                />
      
                <div className="prompt-bar">
                  {status === "error" && generateError ? (
                    <div className="error-box">
                      <div className="error-title">
                        {visible !== null ? "Modification failed" : "Generation failed"}
                      </div>
                      <div className="error-text">{generateError}</div>
                    </div>
                  ) : null}
                  <div className="prompt-bar-inner">
                    <textarea
                      ref={textareaRef}
                      className="prompt-input"
                      placeholder={
                        visible !== null
                          ? "Describe how to modify this part..."
                          : "Describe the part you want to build..."
                      }
                      value={prompt}
                      onChange={(e) => setPrompt(e.target.value)}
                      onKeyDown={handlePromptKeyDown}
                      disabled={busy}
                      rows={2}
                      maxLength={MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH}
                      aria-label={visible !== null ? "Modification instruction" : "Part description"}
                    />
                    <button
                      className="generate-button"
                      onClick={visible !== null ? handleModify : handleGenerate}
                      disabled={busy || prompt.trim().length === 0}
                      aria-label={visible !== null ? "Modify CAD model" : "Generate CAD model"}
                    >
                      {busy ? "Working..." : visible !== null ? "Modify" : "Generate"}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="prompt-footer">
                    <span className="char-count">
                      {prompt.length} / {MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH}
                    </span>
                    <span className="char-count">
                      {busy
                        ? visible !== null
                          ? "Modifying…"
                          : "Generating…"
                        : `Ctrl+Enter to ${visible !== null ? "modify" : "generate"}`}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
      
              <aside className="inspector">
                <Inspector
                  result={result}
                  status={status}
                  workspace={activeWorkspace}
                  onSelectRevision={handleSelectRevision}
                  onRemint={handleRemint}
                  remintBusy={busy}
                  assembly={
                    <>
                      <AssemblyTree
                        name={
                          displayResult
                            ? displayResult.specification.name
                            : activeWorkspace.name
                        }
                        objects={objects}
                        selectedId={activeSelectedId}
                        onSelect={handleSelectObject}
                        onToggleVisible={handleToggleVisible}
                        onRemove={handleRemoveComponent}
                        busy={busy}
                      />
                      <ObjectInspector
                        object={selectedObject}
                        catalog={catalog}
                        draftName={draftName}
                        draftPosition={shownPosition}
                        draftRotation={draftRotation}
                        draftParams={draftParams}
                        placementDirty={placementDirty}
                        paramsDirty={paramsDirty}
                        busy={busy}
                        onName={handleNameChange}
                        onPosition={handleEditPosition}
                        onRotation={handleEditRotation}
                        onParam={(key, value) =>
                          setDraftParams((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }))
                        }
                        onApplyPlacement={handleApplyPlacement}
                        onApplyParams={handleApplyParams}
                      />
                    </>
                  }
                  parametric={
                    visible !== null && paramDescriptors.length > 0 ? (
                      <ParametricPanel
                        params={paramDescriptors}
                        values={paramEdits}
                        busy={committing || busy}
                        previewing={previewBusy}
                        error={paramError}
                        canCommit={paramSession.canCommit}
                        onPreview={paramSession.previewValue}
                        onCommit={handleParamCommit}
                      />
                    ) : undefined
                  }
                />
              </aside>
            </main>
          </div>
        );
      }

- path: frontend\lib\projectStore.ts
  content: |
      /** Firestore persistence for Project → Workspace → Revision (M11).
       *
       *  Layout — one collection per level so a long session never rewrites history:
       *
       *    users/{uid}/projects/{projectId}
       *    users/{uid}/projects/{projectId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}
       *    users/{uid}/projects/{projectId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}/revisions/{revisionId}
       *
       *  The project document holds only the shell (name + which workspace is
       *  active); each workspace document holds its lineage pointers; revisions are
       *  append-only documents. `loadProject` reassembles exactly the `Project`
       *  shape that `lib/revisions.ts` already produces, so the reducers and their
       *  unit tests keep working unchanged.
       *
       *  Access control is enforced by `firestore.rules`, not here: a document path
       *  is always built from the signed-in uid, and a caller cannot ask this module
       *  to read or write another user's data.
       */
      import {
        collection,
        doc,
        getDoc,
        getDocs,
        orderBy,
        query,
        updateDoc,
        writeBatch,
        type Firestore,
      } from "firebase/firestore";
      import type { Project, Revision, Workspace } from "@/types/revisions";
      import type { RevisionKind } from "@/types/revisions";
      import type { GenerateResponse } from "@/types/api";
      import { nowIso } from "@/lib/revisions";
      
      export interface ProjectSummary {
        id: string;
        name: string;
        /** Serial shown on the nameplate, e.g. WS-042. */
        serial: string;
        createdAt: string;
        updatedAt: string;
        workspaceCount: number;
        revisionCount: number;
      }
      
      interface ProjectDoc {
        name: string;
        serial: string;
        activeWorkspaceId: string;
        createdAt: string;
        updatedAt: string;
        /** Denormalized counts so the home list needs no fan-out reads. */
        workspaceCount?: number;
        revisionCount?: number;
      }
      
      interface WorkspaceDoc {
        name: string;
        order: number;
        activeRevisionId: string | null;
        viewerCleared: boolean;
        createdAt: string;
        updatedAt: string;
        /**
         * Set when the owner removes the workspace. The document stays behind
         * because `firestore.rules` keeps revisions append-only — nothing under a
         * workspace may be deleted — so removal hides the plate instead of
         * destroying its history.
         */
        deletedAt?: string | null;
      }
      
      interface RevisionDoc {
        parentId: string | null;
        kind: RevisionKind;
        prompt: string;
        response: GenerateResponse;
        createdAt: string;
        order: number;
      }
      
      function projectDocRef(db: Firestore, uid: string, projectId: string) {
        return doc(db, "users", uid, "projects", projectId);
      }
      
      function workspacesCol(db: Firestore, uid: string, projectId: string) {
        return collection(db, "users", uid, "projects", projectId, "workspaces");
      }
      
      function workspaceDocRef(
        db: Firestore,
        uid: string,
        projectId: string,
        workspaceId: string,
      ) {
        return doc(db, "users", uid, "projects", projectId, "workspaces", workspaceId);
      }
      
      function revisionsCol(
        db: Firestore,
        uid: string,
        projectId: string,
        workspaceId: string,
      ) {
        return collection(
          db,
          "users",
          uid,
          "projects",
          projectId,
          "workspaces",
          workspaceId,
          "revisions",
        );
      }
      
      /** WS-### serial derived from the project id, so it is stable across loads. */
      export function serialFor(projectId: string): string {
        let hash = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < projectId.length; i += 1) {
          hash = (hash * 31 + projectId.charCodeAt(i)) % 1000;
        }
        return `WS-${String(hash).padStart(3, "0")}`;
      }
      
      /** List the signed-in user's projects, newest first. */
      export async function listProjects(
        db: Firestore,
        uid: string,
      ): Promise<ProjectSummary[]> {
        const snapshot = await getDocs(
          query(collection(db, "users", uid, "projects"), orderBy("updatedAt", "desc")),
        );
        return snapshot.docs.map((entry) => {
          const data = entry.data() as ProjectDoc;
          return {
            id: entry.id,
            name: data.name,
            serial: data.serial,
            createdAt: data.createdAt,
            updatedAt: data.updatedAt,
            workspaceCount: data.workspaceCount ?? 1,
            revisionCount: data.revisionCount ?? 0,
          };
        });
      }
      
      /** Read one project back into the reducer's `Project` shape. */
      export async function loadProject(
        db: Firestore,
        uid: string,
        projectId: string,
      ): Promise<Project | null> {
        const projectSnap = await getDoc(projectDocRef(db, uid, projectId));
        if (!projectSnap.exists()) return null;
        const project = projectSnap.data() as ProjectDoc;
      
        const workspaceSnaps = await getDocs(
          query(workspacesCol(db, uid, projectId), orderBy("order", "asc")),
        );
        const workspaces: Workspace[] = [];
        for (const workspaceSnap of workspaceSnaps.docs) {
          const meta = workspaceSnap.data() as WorkspaceDoc;
          /* Removed workspaces stay stored but never come back in the UI. */
          if (meta.deletedAt) continue;
          const revisionSnaps = await getDocs(
            query(revisionsCol(db, uid, projectId, workspaceSnap.id), orderBy("order", "asc")),
          );
          const revisions: Revision[] = revisionSnaps.docs.map((entry) => {
            const data = entry.data() as RevisionDoc;
            return {
              id: entry.id,
              parentId: data.parentId,
              kind: data.kind,
              prompt: data.prompt,
              response: data.response,
              createdAt: data.createdAt,
            };
          });
          workspaces.push({
            id: workspaceSnap.id,
            name: meta.name,
            revisions,
            activeRevisionId: meta.activeRevisionId,
            viewerCleared: meta.viewerCleared,
          });
        }
        if (workspaces.length === 0) return null;
        const activeWorkspaceId = workspaces.some(
          (workspace) => workspace.id === project.activeWorkspaceId,
        )
          ? project.activeWorkspaceId
          : workspaces[0].id;
        return {
          id: projectSnap.id,
          name: project.name,
          workspaces,
          activeWorkspaceId,
        };
      }
      
      /** Create the project shell plus its first workspace. */
      export async function createProjectRecord(
        db: Firestore,
        uid: string,
        project: Project,
      ): Promise<void> {
        const now = nowIso();
        const batch = writeBatch(db);
        batch.set(projectDocRef(db, uid, project.id), {
          name: project.name,
          serial: serialFor(project.id),
          activeWorkspaceId: project.activeWorkspaceId,
          workspaceCount: project.workspaces.length,
          revisionCount: 0,
          createdAt: now,
          updatedAt: now,
        } satisfies ProjectDoc);
        project.workspaces.forEach((workspace, index) => {
          batch.set(workspaceDocRef(db, uid, project.id, workspace.id), {
            name: workspace.name,
            order: index,
            activeRevisionId: workspace.activeRevisionId,
            viewerCleared: workspace.viewerCleared,
            createdAt: now,
            updatedAt: now,
          } satisfies WorkspaceDoc);
        });
        await batch.commit();
      }
      
      /** Persist workspace/active state. Revisions are never touched here. */
      export async function saveProjectShell(
        db: Firestore,
        uid: string,
        project: Project,
      ): Promise<void> {
        const now = nowIso();
        const batch = writeBatch(db);
        batch.set(
          projectDocRef(db, uid, project.id),
          {
            name: project.name,
            serial: serialFor(project.id),
            activeWorkspaceId: project.activeWorkspaceId,
            workspaceCount: project.workspaces.length,
            updatedAt: now,
          },
          { merge: true },
        );
        project.workspaces.forEach((workspace, index) => {
          batch.set(
            workspaceDocRef(db, uid, project.id, workspace.id),
            {
              name: workspace.name,
              order: index,
              activeRevisionId: workspace.activeRevisionId,
              viewerCleared: workspace.viewerCleared,
              updatedAt: now,
            },
            { merge: true },
          );
        });
        await batch.commit();
      }
      
      /**
       * Mark a workspace as removed.
       *
       * The document is kept (flagged) rather than deleted: revisions are
       * append-only, so the security rules forbid deleting them, and a workspace
       * without its revisions would be a broken lineage. `loadProject` filters
       * flagged workspaces out, so the next load agrees with the UI.
       */
      export async function deleteWorkspaceRecord(
        db: Firestore,
        uid: string,
        projectId: string,
        workspaceId: string,
      ): Promise<void> {
        const now = nowIso();
        await updateDoc(workspaceDocRef(db, uid, projectId, workspaceId), {
          deletedAt: now,
          updatedAt: now,
        });
      }
      
      /**
       * Append revisions that are not stored yet.
       *
       * `knownRevisionIds` is the set the caller has already persisted, so an
       * existing revision is never rewritten (revisions are append-only) and a new
       * one costs a single write.
       */
      export async function appendRevisions(
        db: Firestore,
        uid: string,
        project: Project,
        knownRevisionIds: ReadonlySet<string>,
      ): Promise<string[]> {
        const added: string[] = [];
        const batch = writeBatch(db);
        for (const workspace of project.workspaces) {
          for (const revision of workspace.revisions) {
            if (knownRevisionIds.has(revision.id)) continue;
            batch.set(
              doc(revisionsCol(db, uid, project.id, workspace.id), revision.id),
              {
                parentId: revision.parentId,
                kind: revision.kind,
                prompt: revision.prompt,
                response: revision.response,
                createdAt: revision.createdAt,
                order: workspace.revisions.indexOf(revision),
              } satisfies RevisionDoc,
            );
            added.push(revision.id);
          }
        }
        if (added.length > 0) await batch.commit();
        return added;
      }
      
      /** Bump the shell's updatedAt after writes land. */
      export async function touchProject(
        db: Firestore,
        uid: string,
        projectId: string,
      ): Promise<void> {
        await updateDoc(projectDocRef(db, uid, projectId), { updatedAt: nowIso() });
      }

+/**
+ * Remove a workspace and its revisions from the project.
+ *
+ * A project always keeps at least one workspace, so removing the last one is a
+ * no-op: the editor has nowhere to land otherwise. When the removed workspace
+ * was the active one, the neighbour that takes its slot becomes active.
+ */
+export function removeWorkspace(project: Project, workspaceId: string): Project {
+  if (project.workspaces.length <= 1) return project;
+  const index = project.workspaces.findIndex((w) => w.id === workspaceId);
+  if (index === -1) return project;
+  const workspaces = project.workspaces.filter((w) => w.id !== workspaceId);
+  const activeWorkspaceId =
+    project.activeWorkspaceId === workspaceId
+      ? workspaces[Math.min(index, workspaces.length - 1)]!.id
+      : project.activeWorkspaceId;
+  return { ...project, workspaces, activeWorkspaceId };
+}

  content: |
      "use client";
      
      /**
       * Boot screen — a short initialization moment that frames CGEN as an
       * engineering system coming online. The checklist rows are honest: they
       * reflect real readiness signals (schema version constant, WebGL renderer
       * availability, backend health probe already in flight on the page).
       *
       * Never blocks: the page transitions as soon as the checks resolve, with a
       * hard cap so a slow/offline backend cannot trap the user on this screen.
       * All animation is CSS and disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
       */
      import Image from "next/image";
      import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
      import { WalkingMachine } from "./WalkingMachine";
      
      export interface BootChecks {
        /** Schema/version gate — always true when M6 code is running. */
        schema: boolean;
        /** WebGL is available for the 3D preview. */
        renderer: boolean;
        /** Backend answered the health probe (true = reachable; false = not yet). */
        engine: boolean;
      }
      
      const BOOT_STEP_MS = 220;
      /** Hard cap: never hold the user on the boot screen longer than this. */
      const BOOT_MAX_MS = 2600;
      
      interface BootScreenProps {
        checks: BootChecks;
        /** Called when the boot sequence finishes so the parent can unmount it. */
        onDone: () => void;
      }
      
      export function BootScreen({ checks, onDone }: BootScreenProps) {
        const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(0);
        const [exiting, setExiting] = useState(false);
        const [gone, setGone] = useState(false);
        const timers = useRef<number[]>([]);
      
        const allResolved =
          checks.schema && checks.renderer && checks.engine;
      
        useEffect(() => {
          const id = window.setInterval(() => {
            setRevealed((n) => Math.min(n + 1, 3));
          }, BOOT_STEP_MS);
          timers.current.push(id);
          return () => window.clearInterval(id);
        }, []);
      
        useEffect(() => {
          if (revealed >= 3 && allResolved) {
            const id = window.setTimeout(() => setExiting(true), 240);
            timers.current.push(id);
            return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
          }
          return undefined;
        }, [revealed, allResolved]);
      
        // Hard cap — boot must never trap the user.
        useEffect(() => {
          const id = window.setTimeout(() => setExiting(true), BOOT_MAX_MS);
          timers.current.push(id);
          return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
        }, []);
      
        // Fully unmount after the fade-out so the app beneath becomes interactive.
        useEffect(() => {
          if (!exiting) return undefined;
          const id = window.setTimeout(() => {
            setGone(true);
            onDone();
          }, 340);
          timers.current.push(id);
          return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
        }, [exiting, onDone]);
      
        useEffect(() => {
          const pending = timers.current;
          return () => {
            pending.forEach((id) => window.clearInterval(id));
            pending.forEach((id) => window.clearTimeout(id));
          };
        }, []);
      
        if (gone) return null;
      
        const rows: Array<{ key: keyof BootChecks; label: string }> = [
          { key: "schema", label: "SCHEMA" },
          { key: "renderer", label: "RENDERER" },
          { key: "engine", label: "GEOMETRY" },
        ];
      
        return (
          <div
            className={`boot-screen${exiting ? " boot-screen-exit" : ""}`}
            role="status"
            aria-label="CGEN initializing"
            data-testid="boot-screen"
          >
            <Image
              src="/logo-wordmark-light.png"
              alt="cgen"
              width={423}
              height={107}
              className="boot-logo"
              priority
            />
            <div className="boot-subtitle">CAD GENERATION ENGINE</div>
      
            <WalkingMachine />
      
            <div className="boot-status">INITIALIZING ENGINE</div>
            <ul className="boot-checklist">
              {rows.map((row, index) => {
                const done = index < revealed && checks[row.key];
                return (
                  <li
                    key={row.key}
                    className={`boot-row${done ? " done" : ""}`}
                    aria-hidden={index >= revealed ? "true" : undefined}
                  >
                    <span className="boot-mark" aria-hidden="true">
                      {done ? "✓" : "·"}
                    </span>
                    {row.label}
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
            <div className="boot-footer">M6 / READY</div>
          </div>
        );
      }
      
- path: frontend\components\WorkspaceHome.tsx
  content: |
      "use client";
      
      /**
       * WorkspaceHome — the bench index: every workspace as an engraved nameplate
       * (Precision Bench direction). Each plate carries a permanent serial, its
       * revision count and a delete control; selecting one enters the editor.
       */
      import Image from "next/image";
      import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from "react";
      import { AccountChip } from "@/components/AccountChip";
      import type { Project, Workspace } from "@/types/revisions";
      
      interface WorkspaceHomeProps {
        project: Project;
        busy: boolean;
        /** Shown under the intro, e.g. when a removal could not be saved. */
        notice?: string | null;
        onOpen: (workspaceId: string) => void;
        onCreate: () => void;
        onDelete: (workspaceId: string) => void;
      }
      
      const MONTHS = [
        "JAN",
        "FEB",
        "MAR",
        "APR",
        "MAY",
        "JUN",
        "JUL",
        "AUG",
        "SEP",
        "OCT",
        "NOV",
        "DEC",
      ];
      
      function serialFor(ws: Workspace, index: number): string {
        const n = (Math.abs(hash(ws.id)) % 900) + 100 + index;
        return `WS-${String(n).padStart(3, "0")}`;
      }
      
      function hash(s: string): number {
        let h = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i += 1) h = (h * 31 + s.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
        return h;
      }
      
      /**
       * Day/month stamp straight from the ISO string. Going through `Date` would
       * make the server and the browser disagree across time zones on the same
       * revision.
       */
      function stamp(iso: string): string {
        const month = MONTHS[Number(iso.slice(5, 7)) - 1] ?? "";
        return `${iso.slice(8, 10)} ${month}`.trim();
      }
      
      function lastStamp(workspace: Workspace): string | null {
        const newest = workspace.revisions.reduce<string | null>(
          (latest, revision) =>
            latest === null || revision.createdAt > latest ? revision.createdAt : latest,
          null,
        );
        return newest === null ? null : stamp(newest);
      }
      
      export function WorkspaceHome({
        project,
        busy,
        notice = null,
        onOpen,
        onCreate,
        onDelete,
      }: WorkspaceHomeProps) {
        const workspaces = useMemo(() => project.workspaces, [project]);
        /* Two-step delete: the first press arms the plate, the second removes it. */
        const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState<string | null>(null);
      
        const totals = useMemo(() => {
          let revisions = 0;
          let newest: string | null = null;
          for (const workspace of workspaces) {
            revisions += workspace.revisions.length;
            for (const revision of workspace.revisions) {
              if (newest === null || revision.createdAt > newest) newest = revision.createdAt;
            }
          }
          return { revisions, newest };
        }, [workspaces]);
      
        const lastPlate = workspaces.length <= 1;
      
        const handleDelete = useCallback(
          (workspaceId: string) => {
            if (confirming === workspaceId) {
              setConfirming(null);
              onDelete(workspaceId);
              return;
            }
            setConfirming(workspaceId);
          },
          [confirming, onDelete],
        );
      
        return (
          <div className="home" data-testid="workspace-home">
            <header className="home-topbar">
              <div className="brand brand-mark">
                <Image
                  src="/logo-wordmark-light.png"
                  alt="cgen"
                  width={423}
                  height={107}
                  className="brand-logo"
                  priority
                />
              </div>
      
              <span className="topbar-spacer" />
      
              <span className="home-project">
                <span className="home-project-name">{project.name}</span>
                <span className="home-project-note mono">
                  {workspaces.length} {workspaces.length === 1 ? "plate" : "plates"}
                </span>
              </span>
      
              <AccountChip />
      
              <button
                type="button"
                className="home-new"
                onClick={onCreate}
                disabled={busy}
                data-testid="create-workspace"
              >
                New workspace <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
              </button>
            </header>
      
            <main className="home-main">
              <section className="home-hero">
                <p className="home-kicker mono">
                  <span className="home-kicker-mark" aria-hidden="true" />
                  Bench · Workspace index
                </p>
                <h1 className="home-title">
                  Open a workspace<span className="home-dot">.</span>
                </h1>
                <p className="home-sub">
                  Every plate holds one part lineage: prompts, revisions and the solids they
                  produced. Pick one to keep machining, or stamp a fresh plate and start from a
                  sentence.
                </p>
      
                <dl className="home-facts">
                  <div>
                    <dt className="mono">Workspaces</dt>
                    <dd>{String(workspaces.length).padStart(2, "0")}</dd>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <dt className="mono">Revisions</dt>
                    <dd>{String(totals.revisions).padStart(2, "0")}</dd>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <dt className="mono">Last stamp</dt>
                    <dd>{totals.newest === null ? "—" : stamp(totals.newest)}</dd>
                  </div>
                </dl>
      
                {notice === null ? null : (
                  <p className="home-notice" role="status">
                    {notice}
                  </p>
                )}
              </section>
      
              <ul className="tray-grid" aria-label="Workspaces">
                {workspaces.map((ws, index) => {
                  const active = ws.id === project.activeWorkspaceId;
                  const count = ws.revisions.length;
                  const stamped = lastStamp(ws);
                  const armed = confirming === ws.id;
                  return (
                    <li key={ws.id} className="tray-slot">
                      <article
                        className={`tray-card${active ? " is-active" : ""}`}
                        style={{ animationDelay: `${Math.min(index * 70, 420)}ms` }}
                      >
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="tray-open"
                          onClick={() => onOpen(ws.id)}
                          disabled={busy}
                          data-testid={`tray-${ws.id}`}
                          aria-label={`Open ${ws.name}`}
                        >
                          <span className="tray-top">
                            <span className="tray-serial mono">{serialFor(ws, index)}</span>
                            {active ? <span className="tray-flag mono">Last open</span> : null}
                          </span>
      
                          <span className="tray-title">{ws.name}</span>
      
                          <span className="tray-stats">
                            <span className="tray-stat">
                              <span className="tray-stat-k mono">Revisions</span>
                              <span className="tray-stat-v">
                                {count === 0 ? "None" : String(count).padStart(2, "0")}
                              </span>
                            </span>
                            <span className="tray-stat">
                              <span className="tray-stat-k mono">Last stamp</span>
                              <span className="tray-stat-v">{stamped ?? "—"}</span>
                            </span>
                          </span>
      
                          <span className="tray-cta">
                            Open workspace <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
                          </span>
                        </button>
      
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className={`tray-delete mono${armed ? " is-armed" : ""}`}
                          onClick={() => handleDelete(ws.id)}
                          onBlur={() => setConfirming((current) => (current === ws.id ? null : current))}
                          disabled={busy || lastPlate}
                          title={
                            lastPlate
                              ? "A project keeps at least one workspace"
                              : `Delete ${ws.name} — its revisions go with it`
                          }
                          aria-label={armed ? `Confirm delete ${ws.name}` : `Delete ${ws.name}`}
                          data-testid={`delete-${ws.id}`}
                        >
                          {armed ? "Confirm delete" : "Delete"}
                        </button>
                      </article>
                    </li>
                  );
                })}
      
                <li className="tray-slot">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="tray-create"
                    onClick={onCreate}
                    disabled={busy}
                    data-testid="create-workspace-plate"
                  >
                    <span className="tray-create-mark" aria-hidden="true">
                      +
                    </span>
                    <span className="tray-create-k mono">New plate</span>
                    <span className="tray-create-title">Create workspace</span>
                    <span className="tray-create-cta">Start blank →</span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              </ul>
            </main>
      
            <footer className="home-footer">
              <span>Describe · Preview · Adjust · Download STEP/STL</span>
            </footer>
          </div>
        );
      }

Your last commit actually covered this fairly completely. Here’s the precise state by piece, with the files behind each claim.

## New components — probably yes, but vague

The commit renamed `WorkspaceHome` into a much bigger bench-index component, and the commit message/diff reads like a UI pass rather than “here are the new components.” What is unambiguously present now:

- `components/WorkspaceHome.tsx` — a full bench index with:
  - top bar with the logo, project chip, account chip, and `New workspace →` button
  - hero block: `Bench · Workspace index`, engraved title, subcopy, a 3-cell facts strip (`Workspaces / Revisions / Last stamp`), and an error notice slot
  - per-plate cards with serial, `Last open` flag, revision count, last-stamp, and `Open workspace →`
  - per-plate delete button with a two-step `Delete / Confirm delete` flow
  - a dedicated `Create workspace` create plate
  - footer

So if “add new components” meant *give the workspace shelf its own proper UI section and plates*, that part is in.

If you meant *other distinct new components elsewhere* (for example a separate `CreateWorkspacePlate`, `WorkspaceFacts`, or a standalone new panel), I did not find evidence of those extra components as separate files. The last commit’s new surface is concentrated in `WorkspaceHome` plus styling in `globals.css`.

## Delete workspaces — yes

This is now wired, with tests:

- `lib/revisions.ts` — `removeWorkspace(...)`:
  - removes the plate and its revisions
  - refuses to delete the last workspace
  - moves the active pointer to a neighbor when the active plate is deleted
  - ignores a missing id
- `lib/projectStore.ts` — `deleteWorkspaceRecord(...)`:
  - flags the Firestore workspace doc with `deletedAt` instead of destroying it
  - `loadProject` filters out flagged workspaces, so next load matches the UI
- `app/workspace/page.tsx` — `handleDeleteWorkspace`:
  - guests: in-memory remove immediately
  - signed-in: writes the `deletedAt` flag first, then removes locally; on failure it shows a notice and leaves the plate intact
- `components/WorkspaceHome.tsx` — delete button disabled on the last plate, with two-step confirmation and an `onBlur` cancel

And there are tests for both sides:
- `tests/revisions.test.ts` — `describe("removeWorkspace", ...)`
- `tests/projectStore.test.ts` — `describe("deleteWorkspaceRecord", ...)`

So the “no ability to delete workspaces, only create them” gap is clearly closed now.

## Workspace list page UI upgrade — yes

The shelf page got rebuilt into the homepage-style language:

- `app/workspace/page.tsx` shows the home view through `WorkspaceHome` exactly like a homepage shell, with the top bar, hero, facts, plates, etc.
- `app/globals.css` adds the `.home-*`, `.tray-*`, `.brand-logo`, `.home-new`, `.auth-logo`, reduced-motion and small-screen adjustments for that index, rather than the older empty/home placeholder.

So the page that *lists* workspaces is now visually upgraded in the same direction as the homepage.

## Transparent logo across all pages — yes

There are now two committed logo files:
- `public/logo-wordmark-light.png`
- `public/logo-wordmark.png`

And the code search finds `logo-wordmark-light.png` used on every page/screen I can reach in the repo:
- `app/page.tsx` — landing header and footer
- `app/workspace/page.tsx` — topbar back button / brand
- `app/signin/page.tsx` — auth card
- `app/onboarding/page.tsx` — onboard bar
- `components/WorkspaceHome.tsx` — home top bar
- `components/BootScreen.tsx` — boot screen

The landing css and globals css also comment that the wordmark is a transparent PNG cropped to its ink, placed on the dark bars without a plate behind it.

One side effect worth noting: the commit removed the old `logo-removebg.png` references and replaced them with `logo-wordmark-light.png`, so if you intended the *other* transparent file to be the one in use, that did not happen. Right now the repo is using `logo-wordmark-light.png` everywhere.

## So, was it finished?

By the code and the last commit, I’d say:

- workspace deletion — done
- workspace list page UI upgrade — done
- transparent logo across all pages — done

The only soft spot is “add new components.” If that meant the workspace shelf itself got a new UI, then yes, it did. If you meant additional standalone components beyond that, I did not find them in the commit, and I cannot tell which interpretation you had in mind.

If you want me to lock this down for you, the next useful step is to load the skill that can actually open the pages in a browser and check the shelf, sign-in, onboarding, and landing logo rendering, then report what it sees.

onDelete(workspaceId);\n        return;\n      }\n      setConfirming(workspaceId);\n    },\n    [confirming, onDelete],\n  );\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"home\" \"—\" : stamp(totals.newest)}</dd>\n            </div>\n          </dl>\n\n          {notice === null ? null : (\n            <p className=\"home-notice\" role=\"status\">\n              {notice}\n            </p>\n          )}\n        </section>\n\n        <ul className=\"tray-grid\" aria-label=\"Workspaces\">\n          {workspaces.map((ws, index) => {\n            const active = ws.id === project.activeWorkspaceId;\n            const count = ws.revisions.length;\n            const stamped = lastStamp(ws);\n            const armed = confirming === ws.id;\n            return (\n              <li key={ws.id} className=\"tray-slot\">\n                <article\n                  className={`tray-card${active ?
